Use Claude Design to create landing pages and send them directly to HubSpot. After sending a landing page, it’ll be available in HubSpot as a draft, where you can review and publish it. You can also continue editing the landing page in Claude Design and send an updated version to HubSpot before publishing.

With this feature, you can create landing pages directly in Claude without switching between design tools and HubSpot. Claude references your products, brand context, and existing content when generating designs.

Before you get started

Before sending landing pages from Claude Design to HubSpot, review the following requirements and considerations.

Understand requirements
  • You must set up the HubSpot connector for Claude.
  • You must have a Claude Pro, Max, Team, or Enterprise plan.
Understand limitations & considerations
  • Landing pages are the only supported asset type.
  • Updates are sent from Claude Design using the Send button. Asking Claude to update a landing page in Claude chat won’t push the changes to HubSpot.
  • If you’ve already published the landing page in HubSpot, sending it again from Claude Design will create a new version in HubSpot, instead of overwriting the published version.

Send a landing page from Claude Design to HubSpot

Create and edit a landing page in Claude Design, then send it to HubSpot as a draft and review it before publishing.

  • In Claude on desktop or claude.ai, in the bottom left click Design.

  • Create a landing page and make any required changes.

  • When ready to send the landing page to HubSpot, in the top right, click Share.

  • Select More formats and apps.

  • Next to HubSpot, click Send. If HubSpot isn’t available as a destination, select Connect more destinations to connect the HubSpot connector for Claude.

  • The landing page will be sent to HubSpot as a draft. Review the landing page in HubSpot, then publish it when ready.

After sending a landing page to HubSpot, you can continue editing it in Claude Design. Then use the Send button to update the landing page in HubSpot.

If you’ve already published the landing page in HubSpot, future updates that you send from Claude Design will create a new version of the landing page in HubSpot.

Set up a test sync

If you’ve connected a data sync app to your HubSpot account, learn how to set up a test sync. This simulates the data sync process so you can verify and ensure the correct configuration of field mappings and filters.

Before you get started

To run a test sync, please note the following:

  • The test sync option appears only when you’re setting up a new object sync between HubSpot and a third-party app that you’re connecting for the first time.
  • It must be a one-way sync from the third-party app to HubSpot.

Set up a test sync

  • In your HubSpot account, click the settings icon in the top navigation bar. In the left sidebar menu, navigate to Integrations > Connected Apps.

  • Click an app.

  • Click Set up your sync.

  • On the Select the data you want to sync page, select a one-way sync from your third-party app to HubSpot.

  • Click Next.

  • Continue setting up your field mappings, sync rules, and any associations.

  • On the Review page, in the upper right, click Run test sync.

  • On the Results preview page, review the results of the test sync.

    • In the Rule summary section, review the sync rules you’ve chosen.
    • In the Results preview section, review the number of records that’ll sync, will fail to sync, and will be excluded from the sync. You can click the number of records to view the specific records.
    • In the Records preview section, view individual records that’ll sync. Click the Filter by dropdown menu to filter the records.

  • In the upper right, click Close screen to return to your settings page. Or, click Start your sync to start the sync.

  • To delete your test sync, click Actions > Delete test sync.

Set up and use HubSpot for Google Sheets

With HubSpot for Google Sheets, you can access Breeze Assistant directly in Google Sheets to create content, prepare for meetings, summarize data, and complete other tasks. The Sales Email Agent allows you to draft one-to-one sales emails to HubSpot contacts without leaving Google Sheets. Additionally, you can also import data from Google Sheets into HubSpot and use the HubSpot side panel to easily view CRM records.

Before you get started

Before you start using this feature, please note the following:

  • Any HubSpot user who’s also a Google Workspace administrator can install the HubSpot for Google Sheets extension.
  • To give users access to Breeze Assistant, toggle the Give users access to Breeze Assistant switch on in your AI settings.
  • To give users access to the Sales Email Agent, toggle the Give users access to generative AI tools and features switch on. The Sales Email Agent also requires access to your CRM data, customer conversation data, and files data.
  • To import data into HubSpot, you must have permission to create contacts and segments in your HubSpot account.
  • During setup, each user will be prompted to grant HubSpot permission to read and edit their Google Sheets data. This is needed for the extension to work.
  • If your HubSpot account has Sensitive Data turned on, this extension cannot access any data for added security.

Install HubSpot for Google Sheets

To install the extension from the Google Marketplace:

  • Navigate to the HubSpot extension for Google Sheets in the Google Marketplace.
  • In the top right, click Install.
  • In the dialog box, log into your Google account.
  • Review the requested access permissions, then click Allow. Once installed, the extension will show on all Google Sheets for the connected account.

Connect HubSpot for Google Sheets to your HubSpot account

After installing the extension from the Google Marketplace, connect it to your HubSpot account:

  • In a Google Sheet, click Extensions in the toolbar.
  • Click HubSpot for Google Sheets > Open.
  • In the HubSpot side panel, click Sign in.
  • In the dialog box, select your HubSpot user and account.
  • Click Connect account, which will take you to Google to review data access permissions.
  • Review the requested access permissions, then click Allow. Once installed, the extension will show on all Google Sheets for the connected account.

Use Breeze Assistant in Google Sheets

Once you have connected the extension to your HubSpot account, use Breeze Assistant in Google Sheets to create content, prepare for meetings, summarize data, and help with other tasks.

For example, if you’re reviewing a list of contacts in Google Sheets, you can ask Breeze Assistant to summarize recent engagement for that contact or suggest discussion points based on CRM activity.

To access and use Breeze Assistant in Google Sheets:

  • In a Google Sheet, click Extensions in the toolbar.
  • Click HubSpot for Google Sheets > Open.
  • In the HubSpot side panel, navigate the Assistant tab.
  • Enter a prompt and then click the send icon in the bottom right.

Learn more about using Breeze Assistant and common use cases.

Draft and send emails with Sales Email Agent in Google Sheets

Use the Sales Email Agent in Google Sheets to generate and send one-to-one sales emails directly from a Google Sheet. The agent reviews contact properties, recent engagement, and CRM activity in your HubSpot account, then drafts an email based on your prompt.

For example, if you’re reviewing a list of event attendees in a Google Sheet, you can select a contact, specify that you want to follow up after the event, and have Sales Email Agent generate an email draft for you that references their recent interactions and relevant CRM details.

Please note: the following are requirements for sending emails via the Sales Email Agent in Google Sheets.

  • You must have a connected inbox in HubSpot.
  • For accounts with data privacy settings turned on, a legal basis is required to send an email to a contact.

To generate and send an email with Sales Email Agent in Google Sheets:

  • In a Google Sheet, click Extensions in the toolbar.
  • Click HubSpot for Google Sheets > Open.
  • In the HubSpot side panel, navigate the Agent tab.
  • Click the Contact dropdown menu, then select the contact you want to email.
  • If required, select a legal basis for communicating with the contact.
  • Click the Purpose field and select a purpose for your email.
  • In the Additional Details field, enter more information or context if needed.
  • Click Generate Email.
  • Sales Email Agent will generate an email draft from your prompt.
  • In the email editor, you can edit the email draft Sales Email Agent generated.
  • Once done, click Send Email to send the email directly from Google Sheets. Or Continue in HubSpot to review and send the email from the contact record in HubSpot.

Sync Google Sheet data to HubSpot

Once you have connected the extension to your HubSpot account, import contacts from your Google Sheet into HubSpot.

  • In a Google Sheet, click Extensions in the toolbar.
  • Click HubSpot for Google Sheets > Open.
  • On the Home tab of the HubSpot side panel, click Import.
  • On the Import Method screen, click AI contact sync to use HubSpot’s AI to import contacts to HubSpot. Or click Import manually, to import contacts to HubSpot manually.

If you select AI contact sync as import method:

  • Enter a name for your import.

  • In the Import section, select from the following import options:

    • All rows: import every row in your file to HubSpot.
    • Specific range: import only a selected range (e.g., A2:F15, A17:F20).

  • Click the header row dropdown menu and select a header row in which each column header corresponds to a property in HubSpot. You can confirm if a default property already exists to match your header or create a custom property prior to importing. Learn more about property requirements.

  • Click Next: Prepare your data.

  • In the table, review the sheet headings that’ll be mapped to HubSpot properties. If a heading matches an existing HubSpot property, it’ll be selected by default. If there’s no exact match, HubSpot’s AI will suggest a property based on the heading’s name and values. To view more details about a property, hover over its name.

  • To edit a mapping, under the HubSpot field name column, click the dropdown menu for the property and select the HubSpot property you want to map.

  • Click Next: Import contacts.

  • Once imported, you’ll be able to access the HubSpot data in the right panel of your Google Sheet.

If you select Import Manually as import method:

  • Enter a name for your import.

  • In the Import section, select from the following import options:

    • All rows: import every row in your file to HubSpot.
    • Specific range: import only a selected range (e.g., A2:F15, A17:F20).

  • Click the header row dropdown menu and select a header row in which each column header corresponds to a property in HubSpot. You can confirm if a default property already exists to match your header or create a custom property prior to importing. Learn more about property requirements.

  • Click Next: Select data type.

  • Verify that your Google Sheet includes the required fields to create or update records in HubSpot.

  • Select the My sheet includes all required fields checkbox.

  • Then click Next: Upload data.

  • You’ll automatically redirected to the Import screen in HubSpot, where you can continue the steps to import your data to HubSpot.

Set up and use the HubSpot Agent for Copilot

Use the HubSpot Agent for Copilot to access and manage HubSpot CRM data directly from Microsoft 365 Copilot using natural language prompts. After connecting the agent, you can retrieve information, generate insights, create and update CRM records, and log activities without switching to HubSpot.

For example, Sales teams are able to review active deals, update deal stages, create follow-up tasks, and log calls on records. Support reps can view their assigned tickets and update them. Customer Success teams have the ability to compare resolution approaches and results across support channels to identify trends.

Before you get started

Before you begin working with the agent, make sure to fully understand what steps should be taken ahead of time, as well as the potential consequences of using it.

Understand requirements
  • You must have a Microsoft 365 Copilot license or the Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat add-on license with an eligible Microsoft 365 license.
  • A Microsoft 365 admin must add the HubSpot Agent to the Microsoft tenant.
Understand limitations & considerations

  • All interactions remain subject to HubSpot’s API usage limits.

  • You can access the HubSpot Agent through Microsoft 365 Copilot chat and in Copilot within Microsoft Teams.

  • The HubSpot Agent is available on web, desktop, and mobile.

  • The HubSpot Agent respects user permissions as defined in HubSpot. This means users can only view or edit CRM data in Copilot that they’re allowed to view or edit in HubSpot.

Add the HubSpot Agent to a Microsoft 365 tenant (admin required)

A Microsoft 365 admin must add the HubSpot Agent to the Microsoft 365 tenant for the first time.

  • In your Microsoft 365 admin center, navigate to Agents > All agents.

  • Search for HubSpot.

  • Verify that the agent’s status is Available. If the status is not Available, click the agent and select Unblock.

  • On the Users tab, you can configure who can install the agent.

  • To install the agent for all users, click All users in the organization can install.

    • This automatically installs the agent for users in your organization.
    • Users won’t need to search for and add the agent manually in Copilot Chat.

Connect and use the HubSpot Agent for Copilot

After the Microsoft 365 admin has turned on the HubSpot Agent, other users can connect and start using it.

  • Navigate to Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat or Copilot in Microsoft Teams.

  • In the left sidebar menu, under Agents, click HubSpot.

  • In the Copilot chat window, type your prompt and press enter. Or select a prompt from the recommended HubSpot prompts.

  • You’ll be prompted to log in to your HubSpot account. Click Sign in to HubSpot.

  • Select your HubSpot account and the permissions you want to grant to the agent, then click Connect app.

  • In the Copilot chat window, add your prompt and press enter. If you ask Copilot to create or update a record in HubSpot, Copilot will ask for your confirmation before making any changes.

  • Copilot will use HubSpot context when responding.

Frequently Asked Questions

Which platforms is the HubSpot Agent for Copilot available on?

The HubSpot Agent for Copilot is available as the HubSpot Agent on Microsoft 365 Copilot web, desktop, and mobile surfaces.

Will the HubSpot Agent for Copilot require a paid Microsoft 365 subscription?

To access Copilot in Microsoft 365, you must have a paid Microsoft 365 account. Please refer to the official Copilot pricing documentation.

Will the HubSpot Agent for Copilot support multiple languages?

Yes, the agent supports multiple languages.

What HubSpot CRM data will the agent have access to?

You can use natural language prompts to ask the HubSpot Agent for Copilot to access and manage CRM data. The agent’s access varies by object, with some objects supporting read-only access and others supporting both read and write access.

For more information, review the supported objects and their access levels.

Can Copilot update my HubSpot data on my behalf?

Yes. You can use the HubSpot Agent for Copilot to create and update HubSpot CRM records directly from Microsoft 365 Copilot. For example, you can create contacts, update deal stages, add line items to deals, and log calls or meetings.

The actions available to you depend on your existing HubSpot user permissions and the permissions granted when connecting the app.

Does the HubSpot Agent for Copilot require most of your database tagged by persona?

While clean and well-organized data improves the quality of insights, the HubSpot Agent for Copilot does not require perfectly tagged data.

I’m a HubSpot partner who manages multiple HubSpot accounts. Can I connect a specific account to a Copilot project?

You can only connect one HubSpot account at a time to a single Microsoft 365 Copilot account. To work with a different HubSpot account, you’ll need to disconnect the current one and reconnect the desired account from Microsoft 365 Copilot. While you can’t manage multiple connections simultaneously, you can manually switch between accounts.

How long does Copilot retain and/or delete data?

After your data is shared with Copilot, Microsoft 365’s Terms of Service apply. To better understand their data practices, including whether and how long data is retained, we recommend visiting Microsoft 365 Copilot’s Privacy page.

Will the HubSpot Agent for Copilot respect my data localization preferences?

Once your data is in the Microsoft 365 Copilot platform, the terms you have with Microsoft will govern where and how your data is processed in that tool. We recommend reviewing your Microsoft 365 Copilot license terms depending on your plan to best understand where your data will be stored and processed.

Will my customer data be used to train Copilot?

Prompts, responses, and data accessed through Microsoft Graph are not used to train the LLMs that power Microsoft 365 Copilot. For more information on how Microsoft uses your data, we recommend visiting Microsoft 365 Copilot’s Privacy page.

Will the HubSpot Agent for Copilot have access to Sensitive Data?

If your HubSpot account has Sensitive Data settings turned on, a Super Admin can grant the connector read-only access to Sensitive Data properties and engagements during installation or reauthentication. Users must also have the relevant CRM object or property-level permissions to access the corresponding data through the connector. Learn how to configure AI connector access to Sensitive Data and engagements.

How does the HubSpot Agent for Copilot handle user permissions?

The HubSpot Agent for Copilot automatically respects the user permissions defined in HubSpot. This means users can only view or edit in Copilot the CRM data they’re allowed to view or edit in HubSpot. For example, individuals will only see in Copilot data for contacts or deals they have permission to view in HubSpot.

Some CRM objects in HubSpot have customizable permissions. When access is limited to specific contacts, whether for individuals or teams, Copilot will only be able to view those same contacts. Learn more about user permissions in HubSpot.

How do admin controls work for the HubSpot Agent for Copilot?

Admins control permissions and access to the HubSpot Agent for Copilot, ensuring that their organization’s data is handled securely while still providing teams with the tools they need.

To get started, a Microsoft 365 admin must add the HubSpot Agent for Copilot to your organization’s Microsoft 365 environment and choose which users can access it.

A Super Admin or a user with App Marketplace permissions in your HubSpot account must set up the connection for the first time and select the allowed permissions. Once this is done, they can grant access to other users.

Please note: HubSpot users with a Partner seat will need one of the following permissions:

  • Partner Admin permissions (recommended).
  • Super Admin permissions.
  • A custom permission set that includes App Marketplace access.

Once these steps have been completed, authorized users can begin using the HubSpot Agent for Copilot.

How is customer or CRM data kept secure with the agent?

You have control over what data you share, with the HubSpot Agent for Copilot, and the permissions and settings you’ve selected in your HubSpot and third party accounts. You should always carefully evaluate the benefits and risks of any tool you choose to use. For more information on Microsoft 365 Copilot security controls, review their help center.

Can Microsoft copy customer CRM data or lists through the HubSpot Agent for Copilot?

No, it does not have access to copy CRM data or entire customer lists through the HubSpot Agent for Copilot.

Could using this HubSpot Agent for Copilot inadvertently enable competitors to gain insights into a company’s CRM data or strategy?

Prompts, responses, and data accessed through Microsoft Graph are not used to train the LLMs that power Microsoft 365 Copilot. You may also find helpful information by visiting their help center.

Can external agencies or consultants with Super Admin access connect CRM data directly to Copilot without additional oversight?

The HubSpot Agent for Copilot respects the permission access you’ve granted in your HubSpot account. Super Admins or users with App Marketplace permissions control their organization’s access to the HubSpot Agent for Copilot, including external agencies or consultants.

Does the HubSpot Agent for Copilot comply with privacy regulations, such as GDPR, particularly in the EU, and HIPAA in the U.S.?

Once you turn it on, the HubSpot Agent for Copilot has access to standard CRM records. If your HubSpot account has Sensitive Data settings turned on, Sensitive Data access is based on the optional permissions granted to the connector by a Super Admin. These permissions are read-only and can be revoked at any time.

Your use of HubSpot Services is governed by HubSpot’s Data Processing Agreement and, if applicable, Sensitive Data terms and the Business Associate Agreement. Your use of the HubSpot Agent for Copilot is governed by your terms with them. Ultimately, you are best able to assess your compliance needs and how HubSpot fits into them.

Are there potential risks associated with the agent?

We encourage all of our customers to carefully read and understand both the terms that pertain to their HubSpot account as well as the terms of their plan with Microsoft 365. You should always carefully evaluate the benefits and risks of any tools you choose to use.

Can Copilot hallucinate or provide inaccurate data? What can customers do to protect against that?

Copilot can make mistakes. We recommend a few techniques for ensuring that the results produced by the HubSpot Agent for Copilot are accurate and reliable:

  • Make sure your connected account data is up to date and accurate.
  • Have a human in the loop to review, refine, and fact check the output.
  • Ask for citations and references for any important facts and assertions so that you can quickly and easily confirm them in your HubSpot account.
  • Never indiscriminately rely on any AI outputs to make important decisions.
What data does HubSpot collect about AI assistant conversations when using the HubSpot MCP server?

When using HubSpot’s MCP server, HubSpot may collect summaries of tool calls, including the intent of the request and whether it succeeded. We take steps to anonymize names of people, companies or deals. This data is used to monitor connector performance and to help us improve your experience.

Set up and use the HubSpot connector for ChatGPT

Use the HubSpot connector for ChatGPT to get quick answers and deep insights from your HubSpot context in ChatGPT. With the connector, you can:

  • Use chat to get quick, everyday questions answered about your customer context in HubSpot.
  • Use deep research to apply powerful, doctorate-level research and analysis to your customer context for HubSpot records by using natural language prompts.
  • Create and update HubSpot CRM records, including contacts and deals, from the ChatGPT chat window.
  • Generate insights and take action based on your engagement history, including logging emails, calls, meetings, tasks, and notes.
  • Analyze HubSpot marketing campaign performance to track metrics, identify trends, and evaluate content across blog posts, landing pages, and website pages.

Before you get started

Before you begin working with the connector, make sure to fully understand what steps should be taken ahead of time, as well as the potential consequences of using it.

Permissions required Super Admins and users with App Marketplace Access permissions can connect the HubSpot connector for ChatGPT without prior app approval. For all other users to connect, a Super Admin must first

approve the connector. During approval, Super Admins select which data permissions the connector can access and who in the account can install it. Learn more about managing access to apps.

  • The HubSpot connector for ChatGPT is available to all HubSpot customers across all tiers with an OpenAI account.
  • All interactions remain subject to HubSpot’s API usage limits.
  • When creating or updating HubSpot records in bulk, you can only create or update 10 records at a time.
  • Custom validation rules (including pipeline stage validations and association label validations) aren’t applied when creating or updating HubSpot records using the connector.
  • When reviewing data for your website pages, landing pages, or blog posts:
    • Only data from published pages and posts will be available. For drafts, you’ll only be able to access the page or post metadata.
    • To pull performance data for individual pages or posts, you must specify the campaign name and date range in your prompt.
  • When prompting for data for your users and teams (e.g., user roles, team memberships, reporting structures), it is recommended to use first-person language (e.g., my team, my direct reports) for personal context or organization-wide language (e.g., our sales team, all managers) for broader analysis.

Supported HubSpot objects and tools

The connector can create and update CRM records in HubSpot, as well as log activities. It can also access and analyze the full engagement history of HubSpot records, such as emails, calls, meetings, notes, and tasks.

To grant additional access to new objects or new insights data through the connector, a Super Admin must update the connector’s data permissions. After a Super Admin updates the data permissions, each user will need to reconnect the connector to gain access to the newly approved data. Users can access only the data allowed by their existing HubSpot user permissions.

Learn more about what access the ChatGPT connector has to HubSpot objects below.

Approve the connector (Super Admins)

Super Admins and users with App Marketplace Access permissions can connect the HubSpot connector for ChatGPT without prior app approval. For all other users to connect the connector, a Super Admin must approve it and configure its data permissions and install access. To approve the connector, follow the steps to review and approve apps. During the approval process, you can also select which optional data permissions the connector can access and who in the account is allowed to install it.

Set up the HubSpot connector for ChatGPT

Once a Super Admin has granted you access to install the connector, you can proceed to setup the connector.

  • In your ChatGPT chat window, select your profile icon in the bottom left.
  • Click Settings.
  • Click Apps.
  • Select HubSpot, and then click Connect.
  • In the dialog box, click Continue to HubSpot.
  • Authenticate using your HubSpot login credentials.
  • Select the HubSpot account you want to connect to.
  • On the Connecting HubSpot Connector for ChatGPT to HubSpot page, select the permissions that you want to allow for the connector. Then click Connect App.
  • After connecting, you’ll be redirected back to the ChatGPT chat window. You can now use the connector.

Best practices to use the HubSpot connector for ChatGPT

For best results:

  • Include the term “HubSpot” in your prompts to improve accuracy and automatically trigger the connector.

  • Keep your HubSpot data clean to ensure accurate and relevant responses. Clean data yields better insights. Learn more about the HubSpot data quality command center.

  • Add context based on how you use HubSpot (e.g., custom properties, or specific object types, etc.) to make responses more tailored and actionable.

  • Start small by updating a single record before making bulk changes.

  • Always review the changes proposed by ChatGPT before confirming them.

Use the prompt library for inspiration and example prompts.

Use the HubSpot connector for ChatGPT

Use chat
  • In your ChatGPT window, click + icon > More.
  • Click HubSpot to turn on the connector. If your prompt includes the term “HubSpot”, the connector will automatically be turned on.
  • Add your prompt and press enter.
  • If you ask ChatGPT to create or update a record in HubSpot, ChatGPT may show you what the proposed changes are and ask for your confirmation before making any changes.

Please note: it is recommended that you configure the connector to always ask for approval before updates are made. To do this, navigate to the HubSpot connector tool settings in ChatGPT and set Write tools to Needs Approval.

If you set the connector to Always allow, edits may occur without asking for approval.

  • Review the proposed changes. Then type Yes to confirm them or type No to cancel.

  • ChatGPT will confirm that the record has been created in HubSpot and will return a link to the record. Click the link to open the record in your HubSpot account.

Use deep research
  • In your ChatGPT window, click + icon > Deep research.
  • Click the Apps dropdown menu and toggle the HubSpot switch on. If your prompt includes the term “HubSpot”, deep research will automatically be turned on.
  • Add your deep research prompt and click enter.
  • Answer any clarifying questions asked during your deep research query. You can view the progress of the query and the research activity log.
  • Once the deep research report is available, view the report sources in the side panel.
  • You can use the citation inside the report or sources to jump to HubSpot record pages from the deep research report, and continue taking actions inside HubSpot.

Disconnect the HubSpot connector for ChatGPT

  • In your ChatGPT chat window, click on your profile icon. Then, click Settings.
  • In the left sidebar menu, navigate to Apps.
  • In the Enabled apps section, click HubSpot.
  • In the top right of the HubSpot connector for ChatGPT settings, click Disconnect.

Frequently Asked Questions

How do admin controls work for the HubSpot connector for ChatGPT?

Super Admins and users with App Marketplace Access permissions can connect the HubSpot connector for ChatGPT without prior app approval. For all other users to connect, a Super Admin must first approve the connector. During approval, Super Admins select which data permissions the connector can access and who in the account can install it. Learn more about managing access to apps.

Is there a difference between the HubSpot App in ChatGPT and the HubSpot Connector for ChatGPT?

There’s no difference; they are the same. In ChatGPT, the HubSpot Connector may simply be listed as HubSpot App.

What HubSpot CRM data will the connector have access to?

When turned on for your organization, the connector gives ChatGPT access to your HubSpot contacts, companies, deals, tickets, users, line items, quotes, invoices, orders, carts, products, subscriptions, and object segments (lists), and their associations by using natural language prompts to glean meaningful insights from your customer data.

The connector also has access to engagement history, including emails, calls, meetings, tasks, and notes. This allows ChatGPT to provide richer, context-aware insights based on your actual customer communications.

Please note: associations are limited to the same set of objects listed above.

Can ChatGPT update my HubSpot data on my behalf?

Yes, the HubSpot connector for ChatGPT can create and update CRM records and log activities directly from ChatGPT’s chat window. This includes:

  • Creating new contacts and deals.
  • Updating record properties (e.g., deal stages, contact information) and logging notes on records.
  • Creating tasks and follow-ups.

When using these write capabilities, ChatGPT will show you the proposed changes before execution. All actions are attributed in your HubSpot account’s Audit Log to both the user and the ChatGPT connector. Bulk Create and Update actions for a maximum of 10 records in a single request. Always review the proposed changes that ChatGPT shows before execution and take a moment to confirm them.

Will the HubSpot connector for ChatGPT respect my data localization preferences?

Yes. It will respect your data center location when data is routed through HubSpot servers. For example, accounts hosted in the EU will have requests routed through the EU data center.

Does OpenAI train on my data from the HubSpot connector?

OpenAI respects the training settings you have in your account.

  • If you’re using ChatGPT with an Enterprise, Business, or Education plan, your connector data is not used for training, consistent with their standard terms.
  • If you’re on a Free, Go, Pro, or Plus (consumer-tier) plan, you have the option to opt out of model training in your ChatGPT settings. If not, OpenAI may use connector data to improve connector performance (like better tool use and retrieval accuracy), but will not otherwise use it for general model training.
How does the HubSpot connector for ChatGPT handle user permissions?

The HubSpot connector for ChatGPT automatically respects the user permissions defined in HubSpot. This means users will only see in ChatGPT the CRM data they’re allowed to access in HubSpot. For example, individual sales reps will only see pipeline data for deals they have permission to view. Some CRM objects in HubSpot have customizable permissions. When access is limited to specific contacts, whether for individuals or teams, ChatGPT will only be able to view those same contacts. Learn more about user permissions in HubSpot.

How long does OpenAI retain data accessed through the connector?

OpenAI retains data accessed through the HubSpot connector to enable the connector to function within ChatGPT. Upon termination of your OpenAI account, some data may be retained to maintain your service history. For details on OpenAI’s data retention practices, please refer to OpenAI’s data controls FAQ and privacy policy. Learn more about enterprise privacy at OpenAI.

How long does ChatGPT retain or delete data?

When the HubSpot connector for ChatGPT is enabled by third party tools, the terms you have with those third party tools will govern data retention and deletion. To learn more about connectors in ChatGPT, please refer to OpenAI’s Connectors in ChatGPT article. For details on OpenAI’s data retention practices, please refer to OpenAI’s data controls FAQ and privacy policy.

What visibility into audit logs or real-time data do Super Admins have for the connector?

Super Admins can use audit logs to have visibility into which users have connected or reconnected the HubSpot connector for ChatGPT to the account, as well as the date and time of connection. Learn more about what audit logs are available from OpenAI.

How is HubSpot helping customers understand how these connectors work and what risks might be associated with third party connectors?

We encourage all of our customers to carefully read and understand both the terms that pertain to their HubSpot account as well as any connected third-party account, such as the terms of their plan with ChatGPT. We have provided information that we think will be useful and helpful in this knowledge base article, and in these FAQs. You should always carefully evaluate the benefits and risks of any tool you choose to use.

How is customer or CRM data kept secure with this connection?

You have control over what data you share, with what third party connectors, as well as the permissions and settings you’ve chosen in your HubSpot and third party accounts. You should always carefully evaluate the benefits and risks of any tool you choose to use. For more information on OpenAI’s security controls, see Admin Controls, Security, and Compliance in Connectors.

Can OpenAI copy my entire CRM or customer lists through the connector?

No, it does not have rights to copy CRM data or entire customer lists through the connector. For information on how the data that you choose to analyze within ChatGPT is used by OpenAI, please see above.

Could using this connector inadvertently enable competitors to gain insights into a company’s CRM data or strategy?

To learn more about how OpenAI uses your data, check out OpenAI’s data controls FAQ and privacy policy. For details on OpenAI’s data retention practices, please refer to OpenAI’s data controls FAQ and privacy policy. Learn more about enterprise privacy at OpenAI. Like all third party tools, you should carefully evaluate the benefits and risks of use.

Can external agencies or consultants with Super Admin access connect CRM data directly to ChatGPT without additional oversight?

The HubSpot connector for ChatGPT respects the permission access you’ve granted in your HubSpot account. If external agencies or consultants in your HubSpot account have Super Admin access or App Marketplace Access permissions, they can connect the HubSpot connector for ChatGPT in your HubSpot account. Review connection attempts in audit logs.

Does this integration comply with strict privacy regulations, such as GDPR, particularly in the EU?

While HubSpot’s products and tools can support your privacy compliance efforts, use of HubSpot products alone does not make you compliant. HubSpot’s Data Processing Agreement applies to your use of HubSpot Services, and we aim to be as transparent as possible regarding what our features are capable of and the protections we have in place. Ultimately, you are best placed to understand your data protection obligations and whether our Services meet your compliance needs.

Can ChatGPT hallucinate or provide inaccurate data? What can customers do to protect against that?

ChatGPT can make mistakes. We recommend a few techniques for ensuring that the results produced by the HubSpot connector for ChatGPT are accurate and reliable:

  • Make sure your connected account data is up to date and accurate.
  • Have a human in the loop to review, refine, and fact-check the output.
  • Ask for citations and references for any important facts and assertions so that you can quickly and easily confirm them in your HubSpot account.
  • Never indiscriminately rely on any AI output to make important decisions.
I’ve toggled on HubSpot as a tool for deep research, but it keeps creating fake sample data instead. Why’s this happening?
  • There could be different reasons you’re seeing this, including that your account was flagged by OpenAI for violating their Terms of Use.
  • Using another organization’s trademark in a GPT’s name or logo without clear authorization can lead to violations of OpenAI’s policies. OpenAI may remove or restrict these GPTs.
  • Please reach out to OpenAI support (via the chat icon displayed in the bottom right) to identify and resolve your particular issue.
Will the HubSpot connector for ChatGPT have access to Sensitive Data?

If your HubSpot account has Sensitive Data settings turned on, a Super Admin can grant the connector read-only access to Sensitive Data properties and engagements during installation or reauthentication. Users must also have the relevant CRM object or property-level permissions to access the corresponding data through the connector. Learn how to configure AI connector access to Sensitive Data and engagements.

What’s the expected output when I ask ChatGPT to draft an email campaign or workflow? Will the HubSpot connector for ChatGPT build out the marketing emails and workflow? Or will ChatGPT suggest the copy, triggers, actions, etc., in the ChatGPT pane?

ChatGPT will provide the drafted content for you to implement in HubSpot.

I’m a HubSpot Partner who manages multiple HubSpot accounts. Can I connect a specific account to a ChatGPT project?

Currently you can only connect one HubSpot account at a time to a single ChatGPT account. To work with a different HubSpot account, you’ll need to disconnect the current one and reconnect the desired account from the ChatGPT side. While you can’t manage multiple connections simultaneously, you can manually switch between accounts.

Does the HubSpot connector for ChatGPT require impeccable data management (i.e. most of your database tagged by persona)?

While clean and well-organized data improves the quality of insights, the connector does not require perfectly tagged data.

What data does HubSpot collect about AI assistant conversations when using the HubSpot MCP server?

When using HubSpot’s MCP server, HubSpot may collect summaries of tool calls, including the intent of the request and whether it succeeded. We take steps to anonymize names of people, companies or deals. This data is used to monitor connector performance and to help us improve your experience.

Set up and use the HubSpot connector for Claude

Use the HubSpot connector for Claude to bring HubSpot context into Claude. With the connector, you can:

  • Get personalized AI insights in Claude based on your HubSpot records.
  • Visualize insights through different styles of charts and graphs, using your HubSpot context.
  • Create and update HubSpot CRM records, including contacts and deals, from the Claude chat window.
  • Log activities, tasks, and notes in HubSpot directly from the Claude chat window.
  • Generate insights and take action based on your engagement history, including emails, calls, meetings, tasks, and notes.
  • Analyze marketing email performance, as well as create and update marketing emails.
  • Create landing pages in Claude Design and send them to HubSpot.

For example:

  • Marketing teams:
    • Ask to track time spent in each lifecycle stage by HubSpot contacts in the last quarter.
    • Ask to create follow-up tasks from recent email opens.
    • Ask which campaign generated the most revenue in the last month.
    • Ask which marketing email subject lines generated the highest clicks in the last month.
    • Ask to draft and publish a blog post on [topic] with an assigned author, featured image, meta description, and slug.
  • Sales teams:
    • Ask for a summary of active deals organized by name, amount, and stage, and sorted by closing date.
    • Ask to update the deal Enterprise Package Q4 to Closed Won.
    • Ask for the full conversation history with a contact across connected channels, such as chat, email, and SMS, so you have complete context before a call.
    • Ask to summarize all your conversations with [X] from the last month and list any issues that might affect deal closure.
  • Support teams:
    • Ask to summarize the most common questions across inbox or help desk channels this month to identify trending issues.
    • Ask for all open tickets assigned to a rep, sorted by priority and creation date.
    • Ask to log a note on a ticket summarizing your resolution approach.
    • Ask for all open tasks assigned to you this week, sorted by priority.
  • Customer Success teams:
    • Ask to compare resolution approaches and outcomes across support channels to drive consistency and quality.
    • Ask to create a task for you to follow up with [X] next Tuesday about contract renewal.

Before you get started

Before you begin working with the connector, make sure to fully understand what steps should be taken ahead of time, as well as the potential consequences of using it.

Permissions required Super Admins and users with App Marketplace Access permissions can connect the HubSpot connector for Claude without prior app approval. For all other users to connect, a Super Admin must first approve the connector. During approval, Super Admins select which data permissions the connector can access and who in the account can install it. Learn more about managing access to apps.

  • To use the HubSpot connector for Claude, you must have an active HubSpot user account and an active Claude account.
  • You must have a paid Anthropic subscription (Pro, Max, Team, or Enterprise).
  • All functionality in Claude is subject to HubSpot’s API usage limits and guidelines.
  • Claude is a third-party service governed by your terms (consumer or commercial) with Anthropic. Learn more about data and privacy in relation to the HubSpot connector for Claude.
  • The connector is available on the web, desktop, and mobile versions of Claude.
  • When creating or updating HubSpot records in bulk, you can only create or update 10 records at a time.
  • When creating or updating records through the connector, conditional property rules and pipeline stage validation rules are applied. This includes property-level conditional option logic and custom pipeline stage validations configured in HubSpot. Association label validations aren’t applied.
  • When reviewing data for your website pages, landing pages, or blog posts:
    • Only data from published pages and posts will be available. For drafts, you’ll only be able to access the page or post metadata.
    • To pull performance data for individual pages or posts, you must specify the campaign name and date range in your prompt.
  • When creating or publishing a blog post, the following fields are required: author, featured image, meta description, slug, and title. If the author’s email doesn’t match an existing HubSpot author, Claude will automatically create a new one.
  • When prompting for data for your users and teams (e.g., user roles, team memberships, reporting structures), it is recommended to use first-person language (e.g., my team, my direct reports) for personal context or organization-wide language (e.g., our sales team, all managers) for broader analysis.
  • If you have a Partner Seat, explicitly reference the Partner Client Object (PCO) in your prompt to ensure the connector queries that object.

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I get Write access and engagement visibility?

To access Write access and engagement visibility in the HubSpot connector for Claude, you’ll need to disconnect and reauthenticate your HubSpot account.

What HubSpot CRM data does the connector have access to?

When turned on for your organization, the connector gives Claude access to your HubSpot contacts, companies, deals, tickets, custom objects, marketing emails, blogs, users, line items, quotes, invoices, orders, carts, products, subscriptions, and object segments and their associations by using natural language prompts to glean meaningful insights from your customer data.

The connector also has access to engagement history, including emails, calls, meetings, tasks, and notes. This allows Claude to provide richer, context-aware insights based on your actual customer communications.

Please note: associations are limited to the same set of objects listed above.

How long does Claude retain or delete data?

After your data is shared with Claude, Anthropic’s Terms of Service apply (commercial or consumer, depending on your Anthropic plan). Visit Anthropic’s Trust Center to understand Anthropic’s data practices, including whether, and how long data is retained.

Do Anthropic audit logs offer added visibility for HubSpot admins?

Visit Anthropic’s help center, or contact their support team, to understand what visibility or logging features may be available through your specific plan.

Is my HubSpot data used to train Claude?

Anthropic does not use the data you share through HubSpot to train its models except in certain instances, like when a customer chooses to provide feedback or opts into training. Please refer to the terms (consumer & commercial) in your specific Anthropic plan.

Does the HubSpot connector for Claude support multiple languages?

Yes, the HubSpot connector for Claude works well in many languages and will respond in the language the user uses, if that language is supported. For the full list of supported languages, refer to Anthropic’s documentation about multilingual support and supported countries and regions.

What’s the expected output if I ask Claude to draft an email campaign or workflow? Will Claude build out the marketing emails and workflows? Or will Claude suggest the copy, triggers, and actions in the Claude pane?

Claude will provide the drafted content for you to implement in HubSpot.

Can Claude update my HubSpot data on my behalf?

Yes, the HubSpot connector for Claude can create and update CRM records and log activities directly from Claude’s chat window. This includes:

  • Creating new contacts and deals.
  • Updating record properties (e.g., deal stages, contact information) - Logging notes on records.
  • Creating tasks and follow-ups.

When using these write capabilities, Claude may show you the proposed changes before execution. All actions are attributed in your HubSpot account’s Audit Log to both the user and the Claude connector.

It is recommended that you configure the connector to always ask for approval before updates are made. To do this, navigate to the HubSpot connector tool settings in Claude and set Write tools to Needs Approval. If you set the connector to Always allow, edits may occur without asking for approval.

Does the HubSpot connector for Claude have access to delete information from my HubSpot records?

The connector currently supports view, create, and update actions but does not support delete operations. This means the connector cannot delete information from records on your behalf (for example, asking Claude to remove a contact’s phone number). However, you retain full control to delete any data—including data added through the connector—directly within HubSpot.

I’m a HubSpot partner who manages multiple HubSpot accounts. Can I connect a specific account to a Claude account?

You can only connect one HubSpot account at a time to a single Claude account. To work with a different HubSpot account, you’ll need to disconnect the current one and reconnect the desired account within Claude. While you can’t manage multiple connections simultaneously, you can manually switch between accounts by disconnecting one and connecting to the other.

How do I access Partner Client Object data in the HubSpot connector for Claude?

To ensure Claude uses or discovers information from the Partner Client Object (PCO), you must explicitly reference the PCO in your prompt. The connector doesn’t automatically surface PCO data unless you give a direct instruction. For example, ask: “List all clients from my partner client object”. If your prompt doesn’t reference the PCO, Claude may not return PCO information, even if it’s accessible.

Does the HubSpot connector for Claude require impeccable data management (i.e. most of your database tagged by persona?)

While clean and well-organized data improves the quality of insights, the HubSpot connector for Claude does not require perfectly tagged data. It works with contacts, companies, deals, tickets, users, line items, quotes, invoices, orders, carts, products, subscriptions, object segments, offering useful analysis even if your CRM data isn’t perfectly structured.

Is the HubSpot connector for Claude available on the desktop, web, and mobile versions of Claude?

The HubSpot connector for Claude is available on desktop, web, and mobile versions of Claude, and uses the same connection steps for each.

Will the HubSpot connector for Claude respect my data localization preferences?

Your data center location will be respected as data is routed through HubSpot servers. For example, accounts hosted in the EU will have requests routed through the HubSpot EU data center. Once your data is in the Anthropic platform, the terms you have with Anthropic will govern where and how your data is processed in that tool. It’s recommended you review your Anthropic license terms (commercial or consumer, depending on your Anthropic plan) to understand where your data will be stored and processed.

Will the HubSpot connector for Claude have access to Sensitive Data?

If your HubSpot account has Sensitive Data settings turned on, a Super Admin can grant the connector read-only access to Sensitive Data properties and engagements during installation or reauthentication. Users must also have the relevant CRM object or property-level permissions to access the corresponding data through the connector. Learn how to configure AI connector access to Sensitive Data and engagements.

How does the HubSpot connector for Claude handle user permissions?

The HubSpot connector for Claude automatically respects the user permissions defined in HubSpot. This means users will only see in Claude the CRM data they’re allowed to access in HubSpot. For example, individual sales reps will only see pipeline data for deals they have permission to view and update. Some CRM objects in HubSpot have customizable permissions. When access is limited to specific individuals or teams, Claude will only be able to view those same contacts. Learn more about HubSpot user permissions.

How do admin controls work for the HubSpot connector for Claude?

Super Admins and users with App Marketplace Access permissions can connect the HubSpot connector for Claude without prior app approval. For all other users to connect, a Super Admin must first approve the connector. During approval, Super Admins select which data permissions the connector can access and who in the account can install it. Learn more about managing access to apps.

What visibility into audit logs or real-time data do Super Admins have for the HubSpot connector for Claude?

Super Admins can use HubSpot audit logs to have visibility into:

  • Which users have connected or reconnected the HubSpot connector for Claude and the date and time of connection.
  • All create and update actions performed through the connector, attributed to both the user and the Claude connector.

Learn more about what logging is available from Anthropic.

Are there potential risks associated with the connector?

It’s recommended that you carefully read and understand both the terms that pertain to your HubSpot account, as well as the terms (consumer or commercial) in your specific Anthropic plan. You should always carefully evaluate the benefits and risks of any tooling you choose to use.

How’s customer or CRM data kept secure with the connector?

You have control over what data you share with the HubSpot connector for Claude, and the permissions and settings you’ve selected in your HubSpot and third-party accounts. For more information on Anthropic’s security controls, see Admin Controls, Security, and Compliance in HubSpot connector for Claude with Remote MCP. You should always carefully evaluate the benefits and risks of any tooling you choose to use.

Can Anthropic copy customer CRM data or segments through the HubSpot connector for Claude?

No, CRM data or customer segments can’t be copied through the HubSpot connector for Claude. HubSpot admins control organization access to the HubSpot connector for Claude. Once turned on, anyone in their organization can connect Claude to their unique HubSpot data to converse and gain context and insights.

Could using the HubSpot connector for Claude inadvertently enable competitors to gain insights into a company’s CRM data or strategy?

Anthropic doesn’t use data shared through HubSpot to train its models in most cases. But, there may be exceptions depending on your Anthropic plan. You should make sure you read and understand the terms of your license with Anthropic (commercial or consumer, depending on your Anthropic plan) to understand how your data is used, and Anthropic’s Trust Center.

Can external agencies or consultants with Super Admin access connect CRM data directly to Claude without additional oversight?

The HubSpot connector for Claude respects the permission access you’ve granted in your HubSpot account. If external agencies or consultants in your HubSpot account have Super Admin access or App Marketplace Access permissions, they can connect the HubSpot connector for Claude in your HubSpot account. Review connection attempts in audit logs.

Does the HubSpot connector for Claude comply with privacy regulations, such as GDPR, particularly in the EU, and HIPAA in the U.S.?

Once you turn it on, the HubSpot connector for Claude has access to standard CRM records (contacts, companies, deals, tickets, users, line items, quotes, invoices, orders, carts, products, subscriptions, and their associations).

If your HubSpot account has Sensitive Data settings turned on, Sensitive Data access is based on the optional permissions granted to the connector by a Super Admin. These permissions are read-only and can be revoked at any time.

Your use of HubSpot Services is governed by HubSpot’s Data Processing Agreement and, if applicable, Sensitive Data terms and the Business Associate Agreement. Your use of the HubSpot connector for Claude is governed by your terms with them. Ultimately, you’re best able to assess your compliance needs and how HubSpot fits into them.

Can Claude hallucinate or provide inaccurate data? What can customers do to protect against that?

Claude can make mistakes. We recommend a few techniques for ensuring that the results produced by the HubSpot connector for Claude are accurate and reliable:

  • Make sure your connected account data is up to date and accurate.
  • Have a human review, refine, and fact-check the output.
  • Ask for citations and references for any important facts and assertions so that you can quickly and easily confirm them in your HubSpot account.
  • Never indiscriminately rely on any AI outputs to make important decisions.

If you’re experiencing hallucinations or unhelpful outputs when using the HubSpot connector for Claude, please contact Claude support.

What data does HubSpot collect about AI assistant conversations when using the HubSpot MCP server?

When using HubSpot’s MCP server, HubSpot may collect summaries of tool calls, including the intent of the request and whether it succeeded. We take steps to anonymize names of people, companies or deals. This data is used to monitor connector performance and to help us improve your experience.

Can Claude Enterprise admins restrict connector access to company accounts?

Yes. Claude Enterprise admins can restrict users from connecting HubSpot to Claude accounts outside their Enterprise organization using an email address on a verified domain. Learn more about restricting verified-domain connectors to your Enterprise in Claude’s documentation.

Set up and use the HubSpot connector for Gemini

With the HubSpot connector for Gemini, you can bring your HubSpot context to Gemini to surface insights and generate content to be actioned in HubSpot.

For example, marketers can get a list of contacts with a Lead lifecycle stage in HubSpot and get recommended next steps from Gemini. Or Sales reps can get a list of companies that meet certain criteria and have Gemini draft a follow-up email.

With the HubSpot connector for Gemini, you can leverage your HubSpot context in the following ways:

  • In the Gemini app at gemini.google.com.
  • In Google Workspace applications, such as Gmail, Docs, Sheets, and Chat.

Before you get started

  • The HubSpot connector for Gemini is available to HubSpot customers across all tiers who have a paid Google Workspace Business Standard, Business Plus, or Enterprise plan.
  • The connector is currently only available in English.
  • The connector has read-only access for core CRM objects (contacts, companies, and deals), their associations, and default properties.
  • The connector respects the user permissions defined in HubSpot. Users can only view records in Gemini that they have access to in HubSpot.
  • All interactions remain subject to HubSpot’s API usage limits.
  • To connect, use your HubSpot email that you use for Gmail in Workspace.

Set up the HubSpot connector for Gemini

Google Workspace Marketplace app admins control their organization’s access to the HubSpot connector for Gemini. Learn more about Google Workspace Marketplace app admin controls.

The HubSpot connector for Gemini can be installed directly within Gemini at gemini.google.com or by going to the Google Workspace Marketplace.

To install the connector from gemini.google.com:

  • Navigate to the Gemini app at gemini.google.com.

  • In the bottom left, click Settings & Help. Then click Apps.

  • Toggle the HubSpot switch on.

  • Authenticate using your HubSpot login credentials.

To install the connector from the Google Marketplace:

  • Navigate to the HubSpot connector for Gemini in the Google Marketplace.
  • Click Connect.
  • In the dialog box, follow the instructions to link your Google and HubSpot accounts.

Use the HubSpot connector for Gemini in the Gemini app

After setting up the connector, you can use natural language to ask the HubSpot connector for Gemini to give you insights into your contacts, companies, and deals.

  • In your Gemini chat window, type @HubSpot before your Gemini prompt and press enter.

  • Gemini will generate a response using context from your connected HubSpot account.

Below are some examples of ways you can use Gemini and HubSpot together:

  • Marketers can ask: “Show me a list of contacts in the Lead lifecycle stage, and draft follow up notes that I can send in HubSpot”.
  • Sales reps can ask: “Show me a list of deals, and draft follow up emails that I can send in HubSpot”.
  • Support teams can ask: “Show me a list of companies, and recommend a follow up note that I can send in HubSpot”.

The connector is currently read-only. You can use it to fetch information about your HubSpot contacts, companies, and deals directly in Google Gemini. You can also pull lists of these objects based on their default properties.

  • To fetch specific information:
    • Type @HubSpot, followed by your specific data pull request.
    • For example: “@HubSpot show me contact Charley Harber.”
    • Gemini will respond with information on that contact from HubSpot.
  • To pull a segment:
    • Type @HubSpot, followed by your request for a segment.
    • For example: “@HubSpot show me a segment of companies located in the state of Arizona.”

Use the HubSpot connector for Gemini in Google Workspace

Once your admin has allowed access to the HubSpot connector for Gemini, you can also use the connector directly within Google Workspace. From the Gemini side panel of apps such as Gmail, Docs, Sheets, and Chat, enter a prompt to ask Gemini to retrieve a record or use it to fetch information about your HubSpot contacts, companies, and deals directly in Google Gemini. You can also generate segments for these objects based on their default properties.

To enter a prompt in Google Workspace:

  • In the top right of your browser, click the Gemini icon to open the Gemini side panel.
  • In the prompt box, type @HubSpot and select HubSpot under Tools.

Example prompts that can be used:

  • @HubSpot show me contact [Contact First Name and Last Name]
  • @HubSpot show me deal name New Business
  • @HubSpot show me a list of contacts who have lifecycle stage equal to Lead

Disconnect the HubSpot connector for Gemini

To disconnect the HubSpot connector for Gemini:

  • Navigate to the Gemini app at gemini.google.com.

  • In the bottom left, click Settings & Help. Then click Apps.

  • Toggle the HubSpot switch off.

  • Then click Disconnect.

If you need help with the connector, a Google Workspace admin can use the steps outlined here to contact Google Workspace support.

Frequently Asked Questions

General Overview

Which platforms is the HubSpot connector for Gemini available on?

The HubSpot connector for Gemini is available on the web and mobile.

Will the HubSpot connector for Gemini require a paid Google Workspace subscription?

To access Gemini in Google Workspace, you must have a paid Google Workspace Business Standard, Business Plus, or Enterprise plan. Please refer to the official Google Workspace pricing documentation.

Will the HubSpot connector for Gemini support multiple languages?

No, the connector is available in English only.

Is there a difference when accessing the HubSpot connector in the Gemini app or Workspace vs Gemini Enterprise?

Both connectors let you surface HubSpot CRM data directly inside Gemini, but they are built for different Google products.

The HubSpot connector for Gemini can be accessed in the Gemini app as well as Google Workspace apps like Gmail, Docs, and Sheets, and is designed for individuals and businesses using Gemini as an AI assistant.

The Gemini Enterprise connector is designed for organizations using Gemini Enterprise to connect and reason over data from multiple internal and third-party systems to automate complex, multi-step workflows across a business. For more information on how Gemini Enterprise uses your data, click here.

Data Access & Functionality

What HubSpot CRM data will the connector have access to?

The connector has read-only access to contacts, companies, deals, their associations, and default properties.

Can Gemini update my HubSpot data on my behalf?

The HubSpot connector for Gemini is currently limited to read-only access. It can fetch core CRM objects limited to contacts, companies, deals, and their associations within Gemini, but it doesn’t have the ability to edit the data in HubSpot. Associations are limited to contacts, companies, and deals.

Does the HubSpot connector for Gemini require most of your database tagged by persona?

While clean and well-organized data improves the quality of insights, the HubSpot connector for Gemini does not require perfectly tagged data. It works with your contacts, companies, and deals for useful analysis even if your CRM data isn’t perfectly structured.

I’m a HubSpot partner who manages multiple HubSpot accounts. Can I connect a specific account to a Gemini project?

Currently, you can only connect one HubSpot account at a time to a single Google Workspace account. To work with a different HubSpot account, you’ll need to disconnect the current one and reconnect the desired account from Google Workspace. While you can’t manage multiple connections simultaneously, you can manually switch between accounts.

Once your data is in the Google Workspace platform, the terms you have with Google will govern where and how your data is processed in that tool. Will my customer data be used to train Gemini?

How does the HubSpot connector for Gemini handle user permissions?

The HubSpot connector for Gemini automatically respects the user permissions defined in HubSpot. This means users will only see in Gemini the CRM data they’re allowed to access in HubSpot. For example, individuals will only see data for contacts or deals they have permission to view.

Can Google copy customer CRM data or lists through the HubSpot connector for Gemini?

No, it does not have rights to copy CRM data or entire customer lists through the HubSpot connector for Gemini. Google Workspace Marketplace app admins control their organization’s access to the HubSpot connector for Gemini. Learn more about how data that you elect to analyze within Gemini is used by Google.

Could using the HubSpot connector for Gemini inadvertently enable competitors to gain insights into a company’s CRM data or strategy?

Google does not use the data you share through HubSpot to train its models. You may also find helpful information by visiting their help center.

Can external agencies or consultants with Super Admin access connect CRM data directly to Gemini without additional oversight?

The HubSpot connector for Gemini respects the permission access you’ve granted in your HubSpot account. Google Workspace Marketplace app admins control their organization’s access to the HubSpot connector for Gemini, including external agencies or consultants.

Does the HubSpot connector for Gemini comply with privacy regulations, such as GDPR, particularly in the EU, and HIPAA in the US?

Once you enable it, the HubSpot connector for Gemini has access to standard CRM records (contacts, companies, deals, and their associations).

If your HubSpot account has Sensitive Data settings turned on, Sensitive Data access is based on the optional permissions granted to the connector by a Super Admin. These permissions are read-only and can be revoked at any time.

Your use of HubSpot Services is governed by our Data Processing Agreement and, if applicable, Sensitive Data terms and the Business Associate Agreement. Your use of the HubSpot connector for Gemini is governed by your terms with them. Ultimately, you’re best able to assess your compliance needs and how HubSpot fits into them.

  • Never indiscriminately rely on any AI outputs to make important decisions.
