Set up your HubSpot account

When setting up a new HubSpot account, learn how to create your account, invite your team, and customize your default settings. If you use any third-party apps, you might also want to connect them to your account to integrate your systems.

Below is an overview of the account setup tasks you should complete as an admin. Within each section, you’ll find links to detailed instructions for each task.

For in-depth video training, check out Setting Up Your HubSpot Account in the HubSpot Academy.

Create your account

There are multiple ways to create a HubSpot account. The most common method of signing up for HubSpot is with your name and email address. You can also sign up for HubSpot using your Google login or Apple ID.

  • HubSpot’s account creation page
  • Sign up for HubSpot using your Apple ID

After creating your account, you’ll automatically be logged in. Learn more about logging in to HubSpot and troubleshooting password issues.

Secure your account

To further secure your account and lower the risk of unauthorized access, you can set up two-factor authentication (2FA) or single sign-on (SSO) (Enterprise only). If needed, you can also restrict HubSpot employees from accessing your account.

  • Set up two-factor authentication for your HubSpot login
  • Set up single sign-on (SSO) (Enterprise only)
  • Set up single sign-on using Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS)
  • Prevent HubSpot employee access to your account

Invite your team

Invite your team members to the account to start collaborating in HubSpot. You can customize each user’s permissions to control which parts of HubSpot they can access. Once invited, they can log in and set up their profile and personal preferences.

  • Add and remove HubSpot users
  • HubSpot user permission guide
  • Manage your user profile and preferences
  • Create and manage teams (Professional and Enterprise only)

Customize account default settings

While some settings apply only to individual users, such as user preferences, other settings are account-wide and impact all users. These settings include account time zone and language, default currencies, and security. While setting up your account defaults, you can also turn on data privacy-related features.

  • Customize default language and region settings
  • Add and edit your account currencies
  • Set up your company branding in HubSpot
  • Turn on data privacy settings in your HubSpot account

Connect apps to your HubSpot account

If you have contacts and other object records stored in a separate CRM, you can connect that CRM to HubSpot to sync over relevant information. You can also browse HubSpot’s App Marketplace to find and integrate tools you need for your business. Depending on your needs, you can connect integrations from the App Marketplace or build your own with HubSpot’s API endpoints.

  • Connect apps to HubSpot
  • Connect and use HubSpot data sync
  • HubSpot’s App Marketplace
  • HubSpot Developers documentation

Manage AI settings

To use generative AI features in your HubSpot tools, you must turn on your AI settings. You can also manage AI’s access to your data sources. Learn how to manage your AI settings.

Manage your HubSpot subscription

You can manage your current subscription from the Account & Billing section of your account. In this section, you can explore add-ons, update your current subscription, and view your billing documentation.

  • Manage your HubSpot subscription
  • HubSpot billing and payment | Frequently Asked Questions
  • View and download your HubSpot invoices and receipts
  • Update your payment method and billing contacts

If you’re having any technical issues with setting up your HubSpot account, or want to speak to someone about your account, you can reach out to HubSpot Support or your account representative. Learn more about the support resources available to you.

Support your customers

Streamline and scale your support with HubSpot’s service tools. Manage customer queries on your products and services and reply in a timely manner. It’s recommended to set up a live chat and use support tickets to track customer queries. To scale your support, you can also:

  • Manage multiple support channels with help desk.
  • Encourage customers to self-serve with a knowledge base.

Before getting started, make sure you’re logged in to your account. Learn more about logging in to HubSpot.

For in-depth video training, check out the Service Hub Software Certification in the HubSpot Academy.

Set up an inbox or help desk for customer queries

The conversations inbox and help desk are central locations in HubSpot where you and your team can manage and respond to customer queries.

Inbox

In the conversations inbox, messages from all your connected channels will appear, such as email and chat. You can view ongoing conversations, reply to messages, and manually create tickets for each conversation.

You can create a conversations inbox that’s specifically for your support team. Connect a team email address that multiple members of your support team can access to communicate with customers and resolve their issues. You can also connect a Facebook Messenger channel or support form channel to your inbox.

  • Set up the conversations inbox
  • Connect channels to the inbox: Team email | Calling | Chat | Facebook Messenger | Form | WhatsApp
Help desk

Use help desk to consolidate your support process and manage multiple support channels from a single workspace. You can connect and manage tickets from chat, email, forms, calling, WhatsApp, and Facebook Messenger.

You can start managing tickets immediately using the default views, or create custom views to control what’s visible for each team. By default, tickets will automatically be created via all channels you’ve connected to help desk.

  • Set up help desk
  • Connect channels to help desk
  • Create and respond to tickets in help desk

Create a chatflow

You can also connect a chat channel to help desk or the inbox, which allows you to create chatflows. Chatflows are chat widgets that you can add to your website. Any incoming messages will be routed to your help desk or conversations inbox where you can respond.

There are two types of chatflows:

  • Live chat with real-time conversations with a team member.
  • Bot chatflows with pre-set actions.

Connect with customers in the inbox and help desk

After you connect channels to the conversations inbox, respond to customers’ inquiries sent from any channel in one centralized location. You can reassign conversations, comment on threads or move a conversation to another team’s inbox. During the conversation, you can also view contextual information about the customer’s history with your business to keep your response relevant, or change conversation channels.

  • Collaborate with your team in the inbox
  • Compose and reply to emails in the conversations inbox
  • Create and respond to tickets in help desk
  • Chat with your website visitors

Manage support tickets from your customers

When a customer has a support query, you can create a ticket record, log interactions related to the ticket, and track the ticket through pipeline statuses. Once created, any HubSpot activities related to the ticket will be logged on the ticket record. You can manually create individual tickets from your tickets index page, a contact record, or your conversations inbox.

  • Create tickets
  • Set up ticket pipelines and statuses
  • Manage tickets in your inbox
  • Manage tickets in help desk
  • Set up pipeline automation

Create a knowledge base to help your customers self-serve (Service Hub Professional and Enterprise)

Create a knowledge base to help your customers resolve issues independently and deflect queries from your support team.

A knowledge base is an online library of how-to guides, reference docs, and troubleshooting steps for your customers. You can customize your knowledge base’s appearance and manage your content in multiple languages.

  • Create and customize knowledge base articles
  • Customize knowledge base settings
  • Create knowledge base articles in multiple languages
  • Analyze your knowledge base performance

Receive feedback from your customers (Service Hub Professional and Enterprise)

Get direct feedback on your customer experience with HubSpot’s customer feedback tool. Create and conduct surveys on your website, through email, or chat. With regular customer feedback, you can measure your customers’ satisfaction with your product, service, or experience or assess their experience with your support team.Then, use these insights from surveys to improve your products and customer experience.

  • Create and conduct customer satisfaction surveys
  • Create and conduct customer loyalty surveys
  • Create and conduct customer support surveys
  • Create a custom survey

Analyze your support efforts

Analyze the impact of your support efforts by setting up dashboards and reports. For example, track how many tickets each support rep is closing, or the average ticket response time. You can use a pre-made dashboard template or customize dashboards to suit your reporting needs.

  • Create and manage your dashboards
  • Customize your dashboard
  • Analyze your service team’s productivity (Service Hub Professional and Enterprise)

Partners: Marketplace

Install apps in the HubSpot Marketplace

In the HubSpot Marketplace, you can search for and integrate tools you need for your business with your HubSpot account. All apps in the HubSpot Marketplace are reviewed and certified by HubSpot’s team of developers.

This article covers installing apps in the HubSpot Marketplace. If you don’t have the permissions to install an app, you can request an app install from another user. From the app listing, request for app support. If you no longer require an app, you can uninstall the app from your integration settings. Learn more about installing templates and modules or installing assistants and agents.

Permissions required Super Admin or App Marketplace access permissions are required to install apps. Some apps require additional permissions, which you can view in the Requirements section of the app listing page.

Review recommended apps in the HubSpot Marketplace

In the HubSpot Marketplace, you can browse recommendations of apps and Breeze agents personalized for your account based on your account information, activity, and other apps you use.

Recommendations may differ depending on factors like your role, industry, and HubSpot subscription.

  • In your HubSpot account, click the marketplace marketplace icon in the top navigation bar, then select HubSpot Marketplace.
  • View recommended apps in the following categories, among others:

    • Now trending: apps and agents that are being installed by many HubSpot customers today.

    • Most popular: apps with the most installs across HubSpot customers.

    • New arrivals: apps added to the HubSpot Marketplace in the last seven days.

    • What’s working for portals like yours: apps that are frequently installed by HubSpot customers with a similar subscription, location, and industry.

    • Based on your recent Marketplace activity: apps that are similar to ones you’ve installed or viewed on the HubSpot Marketplace.

    • Connect your tech stack: apps that are recommended based on the apps you’re already using.

    • Frequently installed with [app name]: apps that will work well with other apps you currently have installed in your account.

    • Suggestions from how you’re using HubSpot: agents recommended based on which HubSpot tools you’re using.

You can also ask Breeze Assistant, HubSpot’s conversational AI assistant, for app and agent recommendations. This requires the Give users access to Breeze Assistant setting to be turned on in your AI settings.

Understand Technology Partner tiers

Some listings in the HubSpot Marketplace include a badge indicating their creator has achieved a Technology Partner tier proving past success for other HubSpot customers through value, solution maturity, and partnership with HubSpot.

The following tiers are available:

  • Rising: newer app creators that have demonstrated early success and are actively scaling their integration and its support with HubSpot.
  • Leading: more established app creators with an organized support structure that have proven their quality.
  • Premier: highly established app creators with a deep alignment with HubSpot. They have proven strong customer value, excellent customer support, and product maturity.

Integrations without a badge indicate don’t indicate a lack of quality. New or highly specialized integrations could lack a tier badge, but be the best fit for your business’s needs.

Install apps

  • In your HubSpot account, click the marketplace marketplace icon in the top navigation bar, then select HubSpot Marketplace.
  • Click an app card or enter an app name or keyword in the search bar, then click the name of an app in the dropdown menu.

Please note: if your HubSpot account’s default language is set to Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Dutch, or Italian, your search results will show any listings in that language first.

  • On the app listing page, review the following information:
    • Built by: creator of the app.
    • Installs: number of unique HubSpot accounts that have installed this app.
    • Requirements: subscription and permissions required to use the app, including:
      • HubSpot Plan: whether your account’s HubSpot subscription is compatible with this app. To view the app’s availability for different HubSpot subscriptions, click See all compatible plans
      • HubSpot Account permissions: HubSpot user permissions required to use the app.
      • [App] subscription: subscription required in the app’s connecting platform to use the app. For example, a Free, Starter, or Professional Zapier subscription is required to use the Zapier app.
    • Overview: summary of what you can accomplish using the app. To view the complete overview, click See more in the Overview section.
    • Setup guide: instructions for installing and using the app. To access the setup guide, click View setup guide at the bottom of the Overview section.
    • Features: specific actions you can take using the app. To view the features available for different HubSpot subscriptions, click Compare features by HubSpot plan .
    • Shared data: how data will sync from HubSpot to the app and from the app to HubSpot. A single arrow signifies data syncing in one direction, while two arrows signify data syncing in both directions.
    • Reviews: ratings and reviews of the app by customers who have installed it. For apps created by HubSpot with at least 25 reviews, you can view an AI-generated summary of the app’s reviews. Learn more about rating and reviewing apps.
    • Pricing: cost of different tiers of the app. Click a subscription tier for more information about its cost and features.
  • In the top left, click Install. If the Install button is greyed out, the app is already installed in your account.
  • Complete the app’s installation flow. You can find specific instructions in the app’s setup guide in the Overview section of the app listing.

Request an app install

If you don’t have the required permissions to install an app, you can make a request of a user who does have those permissions:

  • In your HubSpot account, click the marketplace marketplace icon in the top navigation bar, then select HubSpot Marketplace.
  • In the search bar, enter the name of an app or agent.
  • In the dropdown menu, click the name of an app.
  • On the app listing page, click Request to install in the top left.
  • In the dialog box, click the Administrator dropdown menu and select a user.
  • Click Send email.

The HubSpot user you selected will receive an email letting them know what app you want to install and what permissions you would require to install it.

Get app support

If you have any issues installing or using the app, you can request support from the app’s creator.

  • In your HubSpot account, click the marketplace marketplace icon in the top navigation bar, then select HubSpot Marketplace.

  • In the search bar, enter the name of an app or agent.

  • In the dropdown menu, click the name of an app.

  • On the app listing page, view the app’s creator in the Built by field in the top left.

  • If the app was built by HubSpot, contact HubSpot Support.

  • If the app was built by another provider:

    • In the More Info section of the right column, click the Support tab.
    • Click an option, such as Email support.

Uninstall an app

To disconnect an app from your HubSpot account:

  • In your HubSpot account, click the settings icon in the top navigation bar. In the left sidebar menu, navigate to Integrations > Connected Apps.
  • Click Actions on the app you want to disconnect, then click Uninstall.
  • In the dialog box, type “uninstall” in the text field and click Uninstall.

Please note: if you are disconnecting the Salesforce integration, there are additional steps that need to be taken after disconnecting. Learn more about disconnecting your HubSpot-Salesforce integration.

Install themes and modules from the HubSpot Marketplace

In the HubSpot Marketplace, you can install free and purchased themes and modules for your website, in addition to apps and Breeze agents & assistants. Learn more about transferring purchased themes and modules to another HubSpot account.

This article covers how to install themes and modules from the HubSpot Marketplace. Learn more about installing apps or installing agents and assistants.

Permissions required Template Marketplace access permissions are required to install themes and modules.

Understand limitations & considerations

  • The HubSpot Marketplace only accepts payment via credit card. All transactions are made through Stripe (where supported), or PayPal. Once you purchase a template, you will be prompted to enter your credit card information.
  • If you requested a receipt at the time of purchase, this will be sent to your email address. To request your receipt after your transaction is complete, please reach out to your theme provider.
  • Certain features of themes and modules downloaded from the Template Marketplace will only be available for certain HubSpot subscriptions. It’s recommended to review the Requirements section of a theme or module listing before downloading it.

Install themes and modules

  • In your HubSpot account, click the marketplace marketplace icon in the top navigation bar, then select HubSpot Marketplace.
  • At the top of the page, click Templates.
  • To find a specific theme or module:
    • Enter its name in the search bar.
    • Click See all [#] templates to see all themes and modules that matched your search term.
  • To browse themes or modules:
    • At the top of the page, click Themes or Modules. You can also browse featured themes and modules and view curated collections.
    • In the left column, select the checkbox next to each filter you’d like to apply. Some filters only support a single selection or have additional options (such as setting a price range).
  • To preview what a theme or module will look like, click Preview on its card. You can view the preview as it would appear on desktop, tablet, or mobile.
  • To learn more about the theme or module, click View details on its card.
  • On the template listing, review the following information:
    • Overview: summary of what you can accomplish using the theme or module.
    • Features: specific actions you can take using the theme or module.
    • What’s included: templates, sections, and modules included when you download this theme.
    • Support: how to request support from the theme or module creator.
    • Customer reviews: ratings and reviews from other HubSpot customers who have installed this theme or module.
    • Getting started guide: documentation from the theme or module creator that details how to use it.
    • About: general information about the theme or module, including its version history and total installs.
    • Requirements: the HubSpot subscription required to download this theme or module.
  • To install a free template:
    • In the top right, click Install.
    • In the dialog box, read any disclaimers, then select the checkbox and click Install for free.
  • To install a paid template:
    • In the top right, click Purchase.
    • In the dialog box, click select a payment option if multiple are available, then click Continue to payment details.
    • Enter your payment details and finish your purchase.

Use downloaded themes and modules

  • In your HubSpot account, click the Marketplace icon in the top navigation bar, then select Marketplace Downloads.
  • At the top of the page, click Modules to view modules downloaded from the Marketplace, or stay on the page to view themes.
  • For themes and modules with an update available, click Install update to update the version.
  • To customize a theme, click the Actions dropdown menu next to its name and select Edit theme settings.
  • To uninstall a theme or module, click the Actions dropdown menu next to its name and select Uninstall.
  • To learn more about how to use your theme or module, click the Support dropdown menu next to its name and select Getting started guide.
  • To get support for your theme or module, click the Support dropdown menu next to its name and select Contact provider.

Install workflow templates from the HubSpot Marketplace

From the HubSpot Marketplace, you can review and use templates to create workflows efficiently or as a starting point for more complex workflows.

Permissions required Edit permissions for workflows are required to create workflows.

  • In your HubSpot account, click the Marketplace icon in the top navigation bar, then select HubSpot Marketplace.
  • At the top, click the Workflows tab.
  • To access the workflow template library:

    • At the top, click Explore more. Learn how to create workflows using workflow templates from the workflow template library.

    • Alternatively, at the bottom of the page, click See all workflows.

  • To review or use a template, click the template name.
  • On the workflow template listing, review the following information:
    • Overview: summary of what the workflow template does, including enrollment triggers and actions, as well as any prerequisites for the template.
    • Details: details about the workflow template including the template’s author, the count of installs, and objective of the template.
    • Legal: any legal details for the template.
  • To use a template, click Use template.
    • You’ll automatically be redirected to the workflow editor with the templated triggers and actions applied.
    • If the template includes an app or agent action, such as the Create Google Sheet row action, you may need to install the app or agent before turning on the workflow. You’ll also be able to review the available workflow templates with each app on the app listing in the HubSpot Marketplace.
  • Continue setting up your workflow

Leave a rating and review in the HubSpot Marketplace

You can rate and review apps, templates, modules in the HubSpot Marketplace, as well as Solutions Partners in the Solutions Directory. This allows you to provide feedback to listing creators and share your experiences with other users.

For example, if an asset or partner is helping you use HubSpot better, it’s helpful to leave positive feedback so other users can have a similar experience.

Before you get started

Before you begin working with this feature, make sure to fully understand what steps should be taken ahead of time, as well as the limitations of the feature and potential consequences of using it.

Understand requirements

In order to leave a review, you must:

  • Be logged into HubSpot
  • Have the app installed in your current account, or have uninstalled it less than 14 days ago.
  • Be reviewing this listing for the first time, including reviews in other accounts.
  • Be one of the first three users in your account to submit a review for this listing.
  • Qualify for HubSpot’s reviewer eligibility.
Understand limitations & considerations
  • It may take up to 24 hours for an update to a review to be published.
  • If your review violates HubSpot’s review guidelines, you will receive a notification email, and your review will be archived. You can leave a new review that follows the guidelines.

Leave a rating and review

  • In your HubSpot account, click the Marketplace icon in the top navigation bar, then select HubSpot Marketplace.
  • Click the Breeze Agents, Apps, Templates, or Solutions Partners tab.
  • Select the listing where you want to add a rating or review.
  • In the Reviews section, click Write a review in the top right.
  • In the review editor, click a star from 1 to 5 to provide your overall rating.
  • Enter the following information:
    • Overall review: details on how well the app is working for you.
    • Pros: what you liked about using the app.
    • Cons: what you disliked about using the app.
    • Review title: a summary of your review. A title will be auto-generated based on the content in the other fields, but you can also manually enter one.
    • Provide private feedback: feedback on the app that goes directly to the app’s team, but won’t be included in your public review.
  • In the bottom right, select the I agree that my review follows HubSpot’s review guidelines checkbox and click Submit review.

Update a review

  • In your HubSpot account, click the Marketplace icon in the top navigation bar, then select HubSpot Marketplace.
  • Click the Breeze Agents, Apps, Templates, or Solutions Partners tab.
  • Select the listing where you want to add a rating or review.
  • On the listing, click Edit your review in the Reviews section.
  • In the review editor, click the Edit reason dropdown menu and select a reason you are updating your review.
  • Make changes to your review.
  • At the bottom right, select the I agree that my review follows HubSpot’s review guidelines checkbox and click Submit review.

Manage HubSpot Marketplace reviews for listings

When a customer purchases an app, agent, template, or module on the HubSpot Marketplace, they will be invited to leave a review 30 days later. Good reviews build trust, while bad reviews offer an opportunity for you to showcase how you respond to critical feedback.

This article covers steps for HubSpot Marketplace developers to request and reply to reviews for their listings. Learn more about leaving a review on the HubSpot Marketplace.

Understand limitations and considerations

  • A listing must have at least 10 reviews to display a star rating.
  • Listing creators may leave up to two replies on reviews. Customers will not be able to respond to this reply on the listing.

Generate a review link

When asking customers to leave you a review, you can include a direct link for them to create the review. Only customers that meet HubSpot’s review guidelines should leave reviews.

  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to Development.
  • In the left sidebar menu, navigate to App Listings, Agent Listings, Theme Listings, or Module Listings.
  • Hover over the listing and click the More dropdown menu, then select View listing details.
  • Click the Customer Feedback tab.
  • In the top right, click Copy review link.

Reply to a review

If a customer leaves a review, you can leave a reply to that review addressing their comments. The customer will then receive an email with the content of your reply, which will be posted on the public listing page.

  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to Development.

  • In the left sidebar menu, navigate to App Listings, Agent Listings, Theme Listings, or Module Listings.

  • Hover over the listing and click the More dropdown menu, then select View listing details.

  • Click the Customer Feedback tab.

  • At the bottom of the review, click Reply.

  • In the dialog box, enter a reply in the Reply field.

  • Click Send.

Request review or reply removal

If a review or reply is offensive, uses profane language or violates HubSpot’s review guidelines, you can request that it be removed. HubSpot will review the request within ten business days.

If the review is removed, you and the customer will be notified, and they will be able to leave a new review.

  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to Development.
  • In the left sidebar menu, navigate to App Listings, Agent Listings, Theme Listings, or Module Listings.
  • Hover over the listing and click the More dropdown menu, then select View listing details.
  • Click the Customer Feedback tab.
  • At the bottom of the review, click Report.

Purchasing templates and modules | Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers and general information quickly about themes and modules purchased from the HubSpot Template Marketplace.

General Information

What is a theme?

A theme is a set of templates, modules, and global content you can use to create an entire website. You can manage fonts, colors, and style settings for theme assets from your theme settings.

When using a theme, you can edit your content and page layout in the drag and drop editor Learn more about using themes.

Can I clone an individual modules?

No, it is not possible to clone or redistribute HubSpot template marketplace modules, including in child themes. This is to prevent distribution or modification issues, especially for paid modules.

How do I update to the latest version of a template?

When updating to the latest version of a theme or module, a new version of the theme or module will be created in your account. This ensures that any customizations that you’ve made to the theme or module don’t get automatically overwritten.

To update to the latest version of a theme or module:

  • {[ local.navMarketplaceDownloads }}
  • To update a module, click the Modules tab. Otherwise, remain on the Themes tab to update a theme.
  • Next to the theme or module that you want to update, click Install update.

Please note: before updating your theme or module, it is strongly recommended to verify the version you’re currently using, as well as the most recently updated version. Skipping multiple versions in a single update may result in inconsistencies.

Purchasing and refunds

Where can I find an invoice for my marketplace purchase?

If you require an invoice or a receipt for your marketplace purchase, you can request one directly from the provider. It is a requirement that providers must give an invoice or receipt when requested.

HubSpot cannot issue a receipt or invoice as HubSpot Marketplace transactions are between the provider and user, through the provider’s payment gateway.

Why is my card being declined by PayPal or Stripe when trying to purchase a template/module?

The most common reason for a card being declined is because the payment provider doesn’t recognize the vendor. You can contact your bank or credit card provider to ask them to approve the vendor.

In other instances, the problem may be due to incorrect data entry, such as an incomplete postal code. Review your information with PayPal or Stripe to confirm that it’s accurate and up-to-date.

How do I request a refund?

Before requesting a refund, please read the item’s installation guide and documentation and check that the item is represented accurately on the HubSpot Marketplace.

To request a refund:

  • {[ local.navMarketplaceDownloads }}
  • To request a refund for a module, click the Modules tab. Otherwise, remain on the Themes tab to request a refund for a theme.
  • Next to the theme or module that you want to refund, click the Actions dropdown menu and select Request a refund.

Please note: all refund requests are between the buyer and the provider. HubSpot does not have any role when a refund is requested. Learn more about guidelines for refund requests on the HubSpot Marketplace.

Request a refund in the HubSpot Marketplace

In the HubSpot Marketplace, providers are responsible for the items they sell to their customers. All Marketplace purchases are between the buyer and the provider via Stripe or PayPal. HubSpot has no control over the transaction.

The guidelines below are curated from common consumer laws and serve as a baseline so customers and providers have consistent expectations. In addition to the guidelines below, some countries may have their own laws about refunds for digital goods that also apply.

Reasons to request a refund

If you’ve purchased an item from the HubSpot Marketplace and experience any of the following issues, request a refund from the provider.

Purchased item doesn’t match description

An item does not match its description when it is, upon purchase, materially different from the way it is represented in its description or preview. If it turns out the item is “not as described” you may be entitled to a refund.

Purchased item doesn’t work the way it should

If an item doesn’t work the way that it should and can’t easily be fixed, you may be entitled to a refund of the item. If the item can be fixed, the provider is required to do so promptly by updating the item on the HubSpot Marketplace.

Purchased item support or setup was promised but not provided

If a provider advertises their item as including item support or setup and you are not provided with that service, you may be entitled to a refund of your purchase.

Purchased item has a security vulnerability

If a purchased item has a security vulnerability and isn’t quickly or easily fixed, you are entitled to a refund of the item. If the item can be fixed, the provider should do so promptly by updating the item on the HubSpot Marketplace.

Request a refund

  • In your HubSpot account, click the Marketplace icon in the top navigation bar, then select Marketplace Downloads.
  • To request a refund for a module, click the Modules tab.
  • Next to the theme or module, click the Actions dropdown menu and select Request a refund.

Reasons why a refund may not be given

If the item matches its description and works the way it should, there is generally no obligation for the provider to offer a refund. Some example situations might include, but are not limited to:

  • You changed your mind and don’t want it after you’ve purchased it.
  • The item didn’t meet your expectations.
  • You bought an item by mistake.
  • You don’t have sufficient expertise to use the item.

What happens after a refund

HubSpot automatically removes the files associated with the item, as well as any dependencies (e.g., pages created, cloned templates and modules) created from the item. When the provider issues the refund through Stripe, the Stripe API notifies the HubSpot platform which removes these templates from the buyer’s account.

Request HubSpot Marketplace app reviews

Good HubSpot Marketplace reviews build trust, while bad reviews offer an opportunity for you to showcase how you respond to critical feedback. You can increase the number of reviews on your HubSpot Marketplace listing by reaching out to existing customers to ask for their feedback. Learn more about managing and replying to reviews.

Send automated review request emails

To capture as many reviews as possible, a review request is automatically sent to each user 30 days after installing an app. You can also set up follow-up emails to remind users to leave a review.

  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to Development.
  • In the left sidebar menu, navigate to App Listings.
  • Click the name of an app.
  • Click the Customer Feedback tab.
  • In the left sidebar menu, click Review request emails in the Review requests section.
  • Select a follow-up option:
    • One-time only: customers aren’t sent any follow-up emails after the initial review request.
    • Recurring: customers are sent a follow-up email every 60, 90, or 120 days after the initial request.
  • If you are sending recurring emails, click the Follow-up frequency dropdown menu and select a frequency. The recommended frequency for follow-up emails is 90 days.

Embed review request on your website

To widen the pool of potential reviewers, you can also request reviews from visitors to your website.

  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to Development.
  • In the left sidebar menu, navigate to App Listings.
  • Click the name of an app.
  • Click the Customer Feedback tab.
  • In the left sidebar menu, click Embed on your website in the Review requests section.
  • To embed a button or link directing the visitor to the review form:
    • In the Embed button or link section, select whether the review request will appear as a button or link.
    • Click the Default language dropdown menu and select the language that will appear in the request.
    • Preview the embed code and how the button or link will appear on your website in the Code snippet and Preview sections.
    • Click Copy embed code, then add the embed code to the HTML of your website.
  • To embed the full review form:
    • In the Embed review widget section, click the Default language dropdown menu and select the language that will appear in the request.
    • Preview the embed code and how the review form will appear on your website in the Code snippet and Preview sections.
    • Click Copy embed code, then add the embed code to the HTML of your website.

Share review link

You can request a review directly from a customer by sending them a link to the review form.

  • In your HubSpot account, navigate to Development.
  • In the left sidebar menu, navigate to App Listings.
  • Click the name of an app.
  • Click the Customer Feedback tab.
  • In the left sidebar menu, click Share review link directly in the Review requests section.
  • Click Copy request review link, then send the link to the customer you want to review your app.

Use the HubSpot Solutions Directory

In the HubSpot Solutions Directory, you can search for a HubSpot Solutions Partner who will help you achieve your business goals in HubSpot.

This article applies to customers who want to hire a HubSpot Partner using the HubSpot Solutions Directory. If you are a partner, learn more about creating a Solutions Directory profile.

  • In your HubSpot account, click the Marketplace icon in the top navigation bar, then select HubSpot Marketplace.
  • At the top of the page, click Solutions Partners.
  • To filter for specific types of partners:

    • At the top of the page, click Browse all partners.

    • In the left column, use the filters for fields like Service, Industry, and Country to find the partners who meets your requirements.

  • Click a partner’s card to view their Solutions Directory profile.
  • On the profile, review the following information:

    • Office location: click an address under the partner’s name in the top left to view that office’s location on a map. For partners who work remotely, hover over the information icon to see the countries where this partner can schedule in-person meetings.

    • Website: click Visit website to view the partner’s official website.

    • Contact business: click Contact business to be taken to a page where you can reach out to this partner.

    • Information: in the left column, view key information about the partner’s specialties and HubSpot expertise.

    • About: review the partner’s description of their business and the services they offer.

    • Badges: view any badges the partner has earned, including:

      • Industry badge: partner has completed certification requirements and submitted evidence demonstrating their expertise in a specific industry.
      • Preferred partner badge: partner has verified expertise working with a specific app.

    • Reviews: view ratings and reviews from other customers who worked with this partner. Learn more about leaving a rating and review for a partner.

Partners: Partner Tools

Analyze partner insights

As a HubSpot Solutions Partner, you can use partner insights to identify key actions to take in your account. This includes clients in danger of not renewing and missing tax or banking information that could delay your commission.

Permissions required Partner dashboard permissions for partner tools are required to access the partner dashboard.

Understand limitations and considerations

  • Only clients you actively manage will appear on the Insights tab.
  • If there are no partner insights that need action, the Insights tab will not appear.

Analyze partner insights

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Partner > Dashboard. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Partner > Dashboard directly.
  • Click the Insights tab.
  • By default, insights are sorted by suggested priority, i.e. highest urgency. To sort by most recent, click the dropdown menu in the upper right and select Most recent.
  • These types of insights are available:
    • Renewal at risk: the client has a renewal within 90 days and low HubSpot usage. This type of insight will disappear when the client’s renewal date has passed, or if their HubSpot usage increases significantly.
    • Commission at risk: a shared deal is in progress or closed won, but your bank and tax forms aren’t complete. This doesn’t affect whether the deal can close, but may delay you receiving your payment.
  • For Renewal at risk clients, you can:

    • Click View client record to view their Partner Client record.

    • Click Learn more to open Breeze Assistant, HubSpot’s conversational AI assistant. Breeze Assistant will automatically run a prompt for suggestions to reduce this client’s renewal risk.

  • For Commission at risk clients, click Go to documents to finish filling out your forms.

Assign the Partner Seat to partner employees

The Partner Seat is a free seat that gives eligible HubSpot Solutions Partner and Provider employees potential access to all features in a client’s HubSpot account. Once you’ve assigned a partner to a Partner Seat, you can set their permissions that client account. You can create a new user with a Partner seat. Alternatively, you can change a user’s seat to a Partner seat from either a Partner account or the Client’s account.

This article covers working with the basic Partner Seat available to all partners. For more comprehensive permissions, learn about Partner Admin access.

Permissions required Partner permissions and seats can only be edited by users with either Super Admin permissions or both Add and edit users and Modify billing permissions.

Understand requirements

To be assigned to a Partner Seat, users must:

  • Be eligible Solutions Partner employees.
  • Have a partner employee email domain that matches the domain in the partner account.
  • Be a user in an existing HubSpot Solutions Partner account.

Add a new user with a Partner Seat

To create a new user in the client’s account with a Partner Seat:

  • In your HubSpot account, click the settings icon in the top navigation bar.
  • In the left sidebar menu, navigate to Users & Teams.
  • In the top right, click the Add users dropdown menu and select Create new.
  • In the Email address field, enter the email address of the partner, then click Next.
  • If the user meets the Partner Seat requirements, click the Seat assignment dropdown menu and select Partner Seat. This option will not appear if all requirements aren’t met.
  • If the user does not meet the Partner Seat requirements, click the Seat assignment dropdown menu and select Core Seat or View-Only Seat.
  • Click to expand the Choose how to set access section and select Start with a template.
  • Click to expand the Choose a template section, then click the Choose a template dropdown menu and select a current user with the permissions you want.
  • In the bottom right, click Next.
  • Review the user’s information, then click Send in the bottom right. This will send the user an email invite to join this account.

Change a user’s seat to a Partner Seat

If you mistakenly added a user to a Core or View-Only Seat and you want to change it to a Partner Seat, there are two ways to do so: in the partner account or in the client’s account.

Change a user’s seat to a Partner Seat in the partner’s account

The user is automatically granted eligibility and access to a Partner Seat when a Partner Admin makes any permission changes on a user in the Partner account.

Change a user’s seat to a Partner Seat in the client’s account
  • In your HubSpot account, click the settings icon in the top navigation bar.
  • In the left sidebar menu, navigate to Users & Teams.
  • Click the Seats tab.
  • Hover over a user and click Change seat.
  • In the right panel, click the Seat dropdown menu and select Partner Seat.
  • In the bottom right, click Save.

Collaborate with HubSpot on shared deals

Shared partner deals create a centralized space for HubSpot Partners and HubSpot sales representatives to collaborate.

After you’ve created a shared deal, you can log shared messages on the deal record to collaborate with your assigned HubSpot sales representative or communicate with them through a shared Slack channel.

Permissions required The deals you have access to depend on your CRM object permissions for deals.

Use shared messages

All content shared with HubSpot sales representatives will appear on the Shared tab of the deal record.

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to CRM > Deals. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to CRM > Deals directly.
  • Click the name of a shared deal.
  • At the top of the deal record, click the Shared tab.
  • To add a new shared message:

    • In the upper right, click Add Shared Message.

    • In the pop-up box, enter a message, then click Send message. The message will sync with HubSpot’s internal system and notify all users in the To be notified section.

  • To reply to an existing shared message, click Reply at the bottom of a shared message, then enter a reply. You can also reply from the email notification.
  • To pin a shared message to the top of the timeline, click the Actions dropdown menu at the top of the message and select Pin. You can only pin one message at a time.
  • To review changes to a shared message over time, click the Actions dropdown menu at the top of the message and select History.
  • To remind the notified HubSpot sales representatives to respond to a message, click Request follow-up at the bottom of the message.

Add messages with Slack

Your HubSpot sales representative will create a shared Slack channel where you can both send messages that will be synced to the shared deal. Once the deal is complete, the channel will be archived after a period of inactivity.

  • Accept the invitation to join the shared Slack channel from your email or from the in-app notification.
  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to CRM > Deals. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to CRM > Deals directly.
  • Click the name of a shared deal.
  • At the top of the deal record, click the Shared tab.
  • Click a link to the Slack channel, or review messages sent from Slack.

Copy partner assets to client accounts

As a HubSpot Solutions Partner, you can create assets in your own account, then copy those assets to your clients’ accounts. This is helpful for creating reusable assets that can be sent to multiple clients. Assets can be copied from sandbox and demo accounts, as well as your main partner account.

Please note: if you’re a Super Admin, you can opt your account into the Partner Portability beta.

Permissions required Partner Admin permissions are required to copy assets to client accounts.

Before you get started

Review the requirements, limitations and considerations of copying partner assets before you begin the process.

Understand requirements
  • You must be a Super Admin or have the Partner Portability permission.
  • You must not be listed as a contractor in your partner account.
  • Before transferring an asset, make sure that you own it or have all necessary rights and permissions to copy and use it.
Understand limitations and considerations
  • Once an asset is copied to a client account, it becomes independent from the original asset. To share any changes with the client, you’ll need to copy the original asset again.
  • For each asset, all dependencies must be copied in order for the copying to succeed. For example, if a workflow enrolls contacts based on form submission, both the form and workflow must be copied in order for the workflow to copy to the client account.
Understand what will be copied

For each asset that you select, the following asset features will be copied to client accounts:

  • Agents: custom agent templates, including only their objective, actions, and input.
  • Workflows: workflows not created in Agent Hub.
  • Forms: form names and form fields.
  • Marketing emails: automated marketing emails.
  • Segments: names and filter criteria.
  • Custom objects: object and custom properties associated with that object.

Copy assets to a client account

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Partner > Client Access Manager. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Partner > Client Access Manager directly.

  • Next to the client, click Copy assets in the Copy assets to client portal column.

  • Select the checkbox next to each type of asset you want to copy, then review what data will be copied.

  • In the bottom right, click Next.

  • Select the checkbox next to each asset you want to copy. To switch between asset types, click the asset name in the Supported asset types section.

  • In the bottom right, click Next.

  • Any connected assets that are required for the assets you’ve selected will automatically be included in the copy. For example, if a workflow sends a marketing email, that marketing email will be included even if you haven’t selected it. Review these connected assets, then click Next in the bottom right.

  • Review any conflicts that would prevent the copy from going through, such as trying to copy workflows to a client account that doesn’t have access to that feature. Then click Next in the bottom right.

  • Review the assets that will be copied, then click Start copy in the bottom right.

You can monitor the progress of the copying process in the copy history for that client account.

Review copy history

For clients that you manage, you can review the history of all assets copied to that client account.

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Partner > Client Access Manager. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Partner > Client Access Manager directly.
  • Next to the client, click View copy history.
  • Review how many assets were copied, which user copied them, when they were copied, and whether the copying was successful.
  • To view the exact assets in a copy event, click the value in the Copy status column.

Create a HubSpot Solutions Directory profile

If you’re a member of HubSpot’s Solutions Partner Program, you can create a profile with your company information to share publicly on HubSpot’s Solutions Directory. This will help HubSpot customers who would be a good fit for your services locate your business.

The Solutions Directory is currently available in Spanish, French, German, Japanese, and Portuguese.

Permissions required Solutions Directory permissions for partner tools are required to edit a Solutions Directory profile.

Create a profile

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Partner > Directory Profile. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Partner > Directory Profile directly.
  • In the Company name field, enter the name of your company.
  • In the Website field, enter your company website.
  • In the Company logo section, click Upload and upload your logo.
  • In the Profile URL field, enter your company name as a string that will be used in your profile URL.
    • To use multiple words, add hyphens between them.
    • For example, if your company name was Partner Solutions, you would enter partner-solutions.
  • To add a physical office location:
    • Click the Office location dropdown menu and select Physical office location.
    • In the Enter office location field, enter the address of your office, then click Save.
    • To add an additional office location, click Add another office location. Enter the address for your second location, then click Save.
    • Repeat for up to 5 total office locations.
    • To edit an office location, click the edit edit icon next to its address.
    • To remove an office location, click the delete delete icon next to its address.
  • To add a remote office location:
    • Click the Office location dropdown menu and select Work remotely.
    • In the Locations where you can meet with clients in person field, enter a city or region, then click Save.
    • To add more locations, click Add another area you serve. Enter a second city or region, then click Save.
    • Repeat for up to 5 total areas.
    • To edit a region, click the edit edit icon next to its location.
    • To remove a region, click the delete delete icon next to its location.
  • In the Company size specialty section, select the checkbox next to each company size you typically work with. This information will not appear on your profile.
  • In the Company description field, enter a description of your company, culture, expertise, and typical clients.
  • In the top right, click Next.
  • Click the Services dropdown menu and select a service where your company excels. Repeat for each additional service.
  • Click the Industry dropdown menu and select an industry that your company specializes in. Repeat for up to 5 total industries.
  • Click the Integrations dropdown menu and select an integration that your company specializes in using. Repeat for each additional integration.
  • Click the Region dropdown menu and select a region where your company has a physical office location or can serve customers remotely. Repeat for each applicable region.
  • Click the Language dropdown menu and select the checkbox next to each language that is spoken fluently by your company.
  • In the Budget section, select an approximate budget range for your company’s services.
  • To preview your profile, click Preview in the top right.
  • When you’re finished creating your profile, click Publish in the top right.

Once you publish or update your profile, it can take up to 24 hours for changes to appear in the HubSpot Solutions Directory.

Add a review badge linking to your profile

You can add a review badge to your website to direct visitors to your Solutions Directory profile.

  • Add the code below to the HTML of your website where you want to display the review badge:

  • Replace [ProfileURL] with the URL of your Solutions Directory profile.

  • If you want to adjust the size of the image, change “width=150px” to reflect the new size.

Create and manage POI confirmation links in your partner account

As a HubSpot Partner, you are required to confirm your involvement with customers purchasing HubSpot. You can create a confirmation link in your partner account that will be automatically sent to your customer as part of their checkout experience. These confirmation links are also known as proof of involvement (POI).

When a quote is created from a shared deal with an attached HubSpot Partner, a POI is created and attached to that deal. You and your Partner Development Manager will receive a notification when the POI is created or updated, as well as when the customer rejects or confirms it.

Permissions required Partner dashboard permissions for partner tools are required to access the partner dashboard.

Manually create a confirmation link

When a quote is created from a shared deal with an attached HubSpot Partner, a POI is automatically created and attached to that deal.

In some cases, you might need to manually create a POI - for example, if the customer rejects the initial link or requests changes to the quote, or if there are any issues with automatic generation

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Partner > Dashboard. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Partner > Dashboard directly.
  • Click the Confirmation Links tab.
  • In the top right, click Create confirmation link.
  • In the right panel, select the checkbox next to each product the customer is purchasing.
  • For each product, click the dropdown menu and select the product tier.
  • If you are providing a product’s required onboarding:
    • Under the dropdown menu, toggle the Providing onboarding switch on.
    • Click the Estimated onboarding duration dropdown menu and select an estimated duration for onboarding this product.
  • To add quantity packs for additional users or contacts:
    • In the Client Hub ID field, enter the customer’s Hub ID.
    • Click the dropdown menu and select each quantity pack included in this deal.
  • To include add-ons, click the Add-Ons dropdown menu menu and select the checkbox next to each add-on included in this deal.
  • In the bottom right, click Preview.
  • In the Name this confirmation link field, enter a name for the confirmation link.
  • Review the confirmation link preview, then click Create to finalize.

Manage confirmation links on shared deals

You can add or remove confirmation links on shared deals from the deal record. For all other deals, reach out to your Partner Development Manager.

Add confirmation links
  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to CRM > Deals. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to CRM > Deals directly.
  • Click the name of the shared deal.
  • On the deal record, click Add in the Proof of involvement section.
  • Select the confirmation link, then click Add.
Remove confirmation links
  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to CRM > Deals. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to CRM > Deals directly.
  • Click the name of the shared deal.
  • On the deal record, click the Actions dropdown menu in the Proof of Involvement section and select Remove from deal.
  • Click Delete.

Manage confirmation links

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Partner > Dashboard. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Partner > Dashboard directly.

  • Navigate to the Confirmation Links tab.

  • In the Client & Status column, review the status of your confirmation links:

    • Pending: client has not been assigned.
    • Confirmed: client has confirmed the confirmation link that was sent.
    • Rejected: client has rejected the confirmation link. A reason for rejection will be included.

  • To view a confirmation link’s URL, hover over the link and click Copy URL.

  • To preview a confirmation link, hover over the link, then click the Actions dropdown menu and select Preview. A preview will appear in the right panel.

  • To edit a confirmation link, hover over the link, then click the Actions dropdown menu and select Edit. You can only edit Pending confirmation links.

  • To make a copy of a confirmation link, hover over the link, then click the Actions dropdown menu and select Clone.

  • To remove a confirmation link, hover over the link, then click the Actions dropdown menu and select Remove. In the dialog box, type Remove, then click Remove. You can only remove Pending confirmation links.

Create partner demo data

As a HubSpot Partner, HubSpot demo accounts help you to showcase HubSpot’s capabilities. Partners in the Elite, Diamond, and Platinum partner tiers have access to additional demo accounts and can generate demo data for those accounts focusing on specific industries.

Understand limitations and considerations

  • Once you’ve generated demo data for your account, it can only be removed manually. If you generate demo data for a different industry in the same demo account, both sets of data will be present until deleted.
  • All partners have access to a single demo account. Only partners in the Elite, Diamond, and Platinum tiers have access to additional demo accounts and can generate data for those accounts:
    • Partners in the Platinum tier have access to one additional account.
    • Partners in the Diamond tier have access to two additional demo accounts.
    • Partners in the Elite tier have access to three additional demo accounts.
  • Only Super Admins can generate data, but all users in your partner account can access or rename demo accounts. Learn more about switching between HubSpot accounts and renaming HubSpot accounts.

Add data to a demo account

Permissions required Super Admin permissions are required to generate demo data.

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Partner > Dashboard. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Partner > Dashboard directly.

  • Click the Resources tab.

  • On the card for an existing demo account, click Add data.

  • Click the Industry dropdown menu and select an industry. The data generated will resemble data from an account in that industry.

  • By default, some potential datasets are selected. Select the checkbox next to each dataset you want to include. Clear the checkbox next to any dataset you don’t want to include.

  • In the Hubs and tiers to demo section, click the dropdown menu next to each hub and select the product tier you will be showcasing. If you aren’t sure which tier to select, Enterprise is recommended.

  • Click Generate data.

Data can take up to 45 minutes to generate in your demo account.

Create shared partner deals

Register your partner leads in HubSpot using the shared deal card on a contact, company or deal record. When you create a shared deal, the deal is automatically registered in HubSpot’s CRM and assigned to a HubSpot sales representative.

Both the HubSpot sales representative and the partner will have visibility to comments, partner compensation eligibility, and associated products and quotes. You can create new shared deals or register existing deals as shared. Learn more about managing shared deals.

Permissions required The deals, contacts, and companies you have access to depend on your CRM object permissions.

Understand requirements

To register an existing deal as a shared deal, the following conditions must be met:

  • As a partner, you must be under your capacity limit.
  • There must be a company and contact record associated with the deal record.

Create a shared deal

  • Navigate to your contact or company records:
    • Contacts: In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to CRM > Contacts. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to CRM > Contacts directly.
    • Companies: In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to CRM > Companies. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to CRM > Companies directly.
  • Click the name of a contact or company.
  • In the right column, click Add in the Shared deal section.
  • In the right panel, enter the details of the shared deal. The deal’s properties have the following sync behavior:
    • Pipeline, Deal Stage, Deal owner, and Associated contact do not sync to HubSpot’s internal records from your partner account.
    • Deal name, Associated company, and Close date sync one-way to HubSpot’s internal records.
      • Once created, any changes made to the deal name will not sync between HubSpot and your account.
      • Once created, if the close date property is adjusted in HubSpot’s internal records, this will sync to the Shared Selling card in your partner account.
    • Deal team and HubSpot product interest sync both ways between HubSpot’s internal records and your partner account.
  • Click Next.
  • Enter qualifying information about the deal in the Intro note, Specific pain/opportunity defined and Next steps fields.
  • Click Create shared deal.

Register an existing deal as a shared deal

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to CRM > Deals. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to CRM > Deals directly.
  • Click the name of the deal.
  • On the deal record, click Convert to shared deal in the Shared deal section of the right column.
  • In the right panel, enter the details of the shared deal. The deal’s properties have the following sync behavior:
    • Pipeline, Deal Stage, Deal owner, and Associated contact do not sync to HubSpot’s internal records from your partner account.
    • Deal name, Associated company, and Close date sync one-way to HubSpot’s internal records.
      • Once created, any changes made to the deal name will not sync between HubSpot and your account.
      • Once created, if the close date property is adjusted in HubSpot’s internal records, this will sync to the Shared Selling card in your partner account.
  • Click Next.
  • Enter qualifying information about the deal in the Intro note, Specific pain/opportunity defined and Next steps fields.
  • Click Create shared deal.

Earn Managed MRR Credit

HubSpot Solutions Partners earn tiers based on the level of success achieved by their clients using the HubSpot platform. The two determining factors for partner tiers are: Sold Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) Credit and Managed MRR Credit.

Managed MRR credit is a measurement of the total HubSpot subscription MRR value that you are actively servicing as a Solutions Partner. It is determined based on the eligible activity within your clients’ HubSpot accounts. As long as you are actively servicing a client in their HubSpot account, you will be awarded managed MRR credit. This credit is converted to managed points that contribute to your Partner tier.

For example, if you are servicing a client that pays USD $1000 a month for their HubSpot subscription, you will earn USD $1000 managed MRR tier credit and 10 managed points that contribute towards your partner tier. Learn more about the conversion of points to currency.

You can review the currency-to-points conversion table here.

You do not need to sell a HubSpot subscription to a customer to be eligible for managed credit while serving them.

Please note: if two or more partners service the same client account, the Managed MRR credit will be divided evenly amongst the servicing partners.

You must complete all the following steps to earn managed MRR credit for a client’s HubSpot account:

  • Create a user in your partner account.
  • Assign the client to said user.
  • Create the same user in the client’s account.
  • Ensure the user performs qualifying activities and is actively engaged in the client’s account.

It is strongly recommended that you have a Partner Admin in a client’s account in order to easily add and manage partner employee permissions in the client’s account.

Qualifying activities are active engagement from the Partner within the client’s account. Each tool has its own set of qualifying activities based on active engagement with that tool. For example, you need to publish a blog post to count as a qualifying activity.

  • Creating and editing assets are considered active engagement in most tools.
  • Simply logging into the client account does not count as a qualifying activity.

Permissions required Client access manager permissions for partner tools are required to access the client access manager.

Earn Managed MRR credit

In your HubSpot account, create a user and set them as a partner employee. All employees can be found in the Employees tab of the Client Access Manager. Employees with a partner employee email domain will have a checkmark beside their email address.

Assign the client to the created employee. The client must be assigned before any partner activities are attributed to Managed MRR credit.

  • If the partner employee is already a user in the client’s HubSpot account and have an email address that matches the partner employee email domain, they will automatically be assigned. You will not need to take further action.
  • If an employee does not have the partner employee email domain, you must manually link the employee to the client’s account for them to receive managed credit for their actions.
    • In your HubSpot Partner account, navigate to Partner > Client Access Manager.
    • In the Employees tab, hover over the employee you want to associate to a client account and click Actions > Link clients.
    • Select a client from the dropdown menu and click Confirm.
  • If the partner employee is deactivated in the client’s HubSpot account:
    • In your Partner account, navigate to Partner > Client Access Manager.
    • Click the Clients tab, then click the name of a client.
    • Hover over a deactivated employee and click the Actions dropdown menu, then select Reactivate user on client.

Please note: only Partner Admins can add or reactivate employees. You can link employees as long as you have access to the Client Access Manager.

You will receive Managed MRR credit as long as your employees are set up correctly and consistently perform qualifying activities in the client’s account.

  • Each qualifying activity performed by each employee counts towards Managed MRR credit for 60 days, after which it will expire.
  • Once the activities of all partner employees in the client account expire, you will stop receiving Managed MRR credit.

Please note: certain partner tiers have additional requirements for the number of qualifying activities that must be performed in a given timeframe.

To confirm if you’re receiving Managed MRR credit for your employee’s activity in the client’s account:

  • In your HubSpot account, click More, then navigate to Partner > Dashboard. If More doesn’t appear in your account, navigate to Partner > Dashboard directly.
  • Click the Points Breakdown tab.
  • Use the search bar to search for a specific client.
  • In the Managed column, review the Managed MRR Credit in the client’s account currency and the Managed Tier points associated with the client.

End the managed client relationship

You will no longer receive Managed MRR credit after ending a managed relationship with a client. Any one of the following actions will immediately end a managed relationship:

  • Removing all partner employee from a client’s HubSpot account.
  • Removing all partner employees managing the client from your Partner account.

To remove all partner employees from a client’s HubSpot account:

  • In your Partner account, navigate to Partner > Client Access Manager.
  • In the Clients tab, click the Access types filter and select all the checkboxes. This ensures you have a list of clients that any of your employees have access to.
  • Click the name of the client you want to end the managed relationship with.
  • Select the checkbox to select all employees.
  • Click Remove partner employee.
  • In the wizard, review all employees and the assets affected.
  • Click Confirm removal.

Doing the following will not immediately end a managed relationship between you and your HubSpot client. The relationship will only end 60 days after the last qualifying partner activity in the client account:

  • Deactivating all partner employees who manage the client in your partner account.
  • Ceasing all partner activity in the client’s account.

Grant Partner Admin permissions to partner employees

Partner Admins are partner employees who can manage your HubSpot account and assign permissions to other partners without the need for a paid seat.

This article applies to HubSpot customers working with HubSpot Solutions Partners. If you are a HubSpot Solutions Partner, learn more about managing Partner Admins.

Permissions required Super Admin permissions or Add and edit users permissions are required to create and manage Partner Admins.

Please note: starting January 13, 2026, all existing users with Partner Admin permissions will be using the standard Partner Admin template. It’s recommended to review the users who have Partner Admin permissions in your account.

Understand limitations and considerations

  • You must assign a partner employee a Partner Seat before you can make them a Partner Admin.

  • Partner Admins cannot do the following :

    • Add or remove Super Admins.
    • Make changes to your billing settings.
    • Manage Sensitive Data.

Create Partner Admins

There are three ways you can make a partner employee a Partner Admin in your account:

  • Access link: the partner employee sends you an Access Link for approval.
  • Migration: the partner employee or client migrates the partner from Super Admin to Partner Admin.
  • Client Creation: the client creates the Partner Admin directly in their account.
Approve a Partner Admin access link

A partner employee can send you a Partner Admin access link directly, which you can use to approve them as a Partner Admin.

  • Have the partner employee send you a Partner Admin access link.
  • Click on the access link, then click Approve.
  • Select the HubSpot account the partner will be able to access.
Migrate a Super Admin to Partner Admin

If the partner employee is already a Super Admin in your HubSpot account, you can either:

  • Have the partner employee migrate themselves in their Partner account.
  • Edit their user permissions to make them a Partner Admin instead.
Create a new user as a Partner Admin

You can also create a Partner Admin directly in your HubSpot account. When setting up a Partner Admin, the Partner Admin permission set will only appear for eligible partner employees. If the user is not an eligible partner employee, this option will not display.

  • In your HubSpot account, click the settings icon in the top navigation bar.
  • In the left sidebar menu, navigate to Users & Teams.
  • In the upper right, click Create user.
  • Enter the user’s email address, then click Next.
  • In the Choose how to set access section, select Start with a template.
  • Click to expand the Choose a template section, then select Partner Admin.
  • In the bottom right, click Next.
  • In the bottom right, click Invite.

Manage Partner employee access to client accounts

Partner Admins can manage partner employee permissions in their clients’ HubSpot accounts directly from their Partner account.

Understand limitations and considerations

Partner Admins cannot do the following :

  • Add, remove, or downgrade Super Admins.
  • Make changes to billing settings.
  • Make payments.
  • Manage Sensitive Data.

Please note: if you need billing access, request that a Super Admin in the client account grant your user the Modify billing and change name on contract permission.

Become a Partner Admin

Permissions required To become or make another partner employee a Partner Admin, you need to be a Super Admin or have Client access manager permissions.

To set yourself or another employee as a Partner Admin in a client’s account, you must give that client your or that employee’s access link.

Send your own access link
  • In your Partner account, navigate to Partner > Client Access Manager.
  • In the upper-right, click Get access link.
  • In the dialog box, click Copy link to copy your personal access link.
  • Send the link to your clients.
  • Once a client opens and approves your access link, you will be created as a partner employee in their HubSpot account with Partner Admin permissions.
  • You will receive an email when your client has approved your access link.
Send another employee’s access link
  • In your Partner account, navigate to Partner > Client Access Manager.
  • Click the Employees tab.
  • Click the name of the employee.
  • In the top right, click the Actions dropdown menu and select Copy access link.

Add employees to a client’s HubSpot account

As a Partner Admin, you can add employees to client accounts directly from your partner account.

  • In your HubSpot Partner account, navigate to Partner > Client Access Manager.
  • Hover over a client and click the Actions dropdown menu, then select Add employees.
  • In the right panel, click the Employees dropdown menu and select the checkbox next to each employee you want to add.
  • Click the Permissions set dropdown menu and select a permission set.
  • Click Add employees.

All employees can be found in the Employees tab of the Client Access Manager. Employees with a partner employee email domain will have a checkmark beside their email address. When an employee is added to your client’s HubSpot account, they will have access to the Partner Seat.

Manually link existing employees to a client’s HubSpot account

If an employee without a partner employee email domain already exists in the client’s account, you must manually link the employee to the client’s account for them to receive managed credit. To manually link an employee:

  • In your HubSpot Partner account, navigate to Partner > Client Access Manager.
  • Click the Employees tab.
  • Hover over an employee, then click the Actions dropdown menu and select Link clients.
  • In the dialog box, click the dropdown menu and select a client. Repeat for each additional client.
  • Click Confirm.

Update employee permissions in a client’s HubSpot account

As a Partner Admin, you can update partner employees’ permissions in a client account from your Partner account.

  • In your HubSpot Partner account, navigate to Partner > Client Access Manager.
  • Hover over a client and click the Actions dropdown menu, then select Details.
  • Hover over an employee and click the Actions dropdown menu, then select Change permission set.
  • Click the Permission set dropdown menu and select a permission set.
  • Click Confirm.

Remove employees from the client’s HubSpot account

Partner Admins can remove employees from a client’s account via the Partner account. In order to end the managed relationship between a partner and client, you must remove all employees from the client account.

Removing all partner employees from the client account does not immediately end a managed relationship between a partner and client. Once all employees are deactivated, the relationship will end 60 days after the last qualifying partner activity in the client account.

Permissions required To remove employees from a client account, you need to be a Super Admin or have Client access manager permissions.

Remove an employee from client accounts
  • In your Partner account, navigate to Partner > Client Access Manager.
  • Click the Employees tab.
  • Hover over an employee and click Remove employee from clients.
  • Select the checkbox next to each client account where you want to remove the employee.
  • Click Next.
  • Review the removal information, then click Done.
Remove all employees from one client account
  • In your Partner account, navigate to Partner > Client Access Manager.
  • Click the name of the client. If you don’t see the client account, click the Access types filter at the top of the page and select all checkboxes.
  • At the top of the table, select the checkbox to select all employees.
  • Click Remove partner employee.
  • Review all employees and assets, then click Confirm removal.

Migrate from Super Admin to Partner Admin

If you are already a Super Admin in a client account, you can become a Partner Admin through your partner account. Once you are a Partner Admin, you can use the Client Access Manager to change other Super Admins to Partner Admins.

  • In your HubSpot Partner account, navigate to Partner > Client Access Manager.
  • Hover over the client account and click Change to Partner Admin.
  • Click Confirm.
